Create `client/src/components/inbox/inboxFormat.js`:

```js
import {
  chicagoDay, chicagoTime, chicagoWeekday, chicagoWeekdayDate, chicagoHour, chicagoInstant, chicagoDayLabel, addDays,
} from '../../utils/chicagoDay';
import { fmtDate } from '../adminos/format';

// Pure view model for the Inbox page (spec docs/superpowers/specs/
// 2026-10-06-inbox-design.md, sections 4 and 11). No React, no fetching, no
// clock of its own: every time-dependent helper takes `nowMs`. Every time it
// prints is Chicago time (decision 28).

// Mirrors server/utils/inbox/constants.js HOT_HOURS: a wait this long is red.
export const HOT_HOURS = 24;
// The design's middle tone for a desktop row icon (InboxDesktop.dc.html).
export const WARN_HOURS = 4;
// How long an Undo toast stays up (the design's 4200 ms, spec 4.4 "about 4 s").
export const UNDO_TOAST_MS = 4200;

// Person keys exactly as strict as lane inbox-engine's parsePersonKey, so a
// key the server would refuse reads as gone here, never as a Retry that
// cannot succeed: c- and s- are row ids written one way (no leading zeros, at
// most int4), p- is the last 10 digits of a number, t- a Thumbtack thread id.
const ROW_KEY = /^[cs]-(0|[1-9]\d{0,9})$/;
const OTHER_KEY = /^(?:p-\d{10}|t-[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,100})$/;
export function isPersonKey(key) {
  if (typeof key !== 'string') return false;
  const row = ROW_KEY.exec(key);
  return row ? Number(row[1]) <= 2147483647 : OTHER_KEY.test(key);
}

// Channel tokens: the list payload's `channels` and `channel` strings, and
// thread rows mapped through threadChannel(). Email, Zola and Google Voice
// arrive with pieces 3 and 4; their labels are ready.
const CHANNEL_LABELS = {
  thumbtack: 'Thumbtack',
  text_888: 'Text 888',
  text_1922: 'Text 1922',
  text_0082: 'Text 0082',
  staff_text: 'Staff text',
  email: 'Email',
  zola: 'Zola',
  voice: 'Google Voice',
};
const CHANNEL_ICONS = {
  thumbtack: 'card', text_888: 'chat', text_1922: 'chat', text_0082: 'chat',
  staff_text: 'userplus', email: 'mail', zola: 'book', voice: 'phone',
};

export function channelLabel(token) {
  if (CHANNEL_LABELS[token]) return CHANNEL_LABELS[token];
  const s = String(token || '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
  return s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : '';
}

export function channelIcon(token) {
  return CHANNEL_ICONS[token] || 'chat';
}

/** A thread row's channel token. A text with no line is the 888 (spec 5.8). */
export function threadChannel(row) {
  if (!row) return '';
  if (row.channel === 'text') return `text_${row.line || '888'}`;
  return row.channel || '';
}

/** Distinct channel tokens of the thread's messages, first seen first. */
export function threadChannels(thread, sinceIso) {
  const since = sinceIso ? Date.parse(sinceIso) : NaN;
  const out = [];
  for (const row of thread || []) {
    if (!row || row.direction === 'system') continue;
    if (!Number.isNaN(since) && Date.parse(row.at) < since) continue;
    const token = threadChannel(row);
    if (token && !out.includes(token)) out.push(token);
  }
  return out;
}

/** "Text 1922" for one channel, else "2 channels" (the phone's MESSAGES head). */
export function channelCount(tokens) {
  const list = tokens || [];
  if (list.length === 0) return '';
  if (list.length === 1) return channelLabel(list[0]);
  return `${list.length} channels`;
}

/** "Text 1922 + Email" (the desktop thread header). */
export function channelJoin(tokens) {
  return (tokens || []).map(channelLabel).join(' + ');
}

/**
 * The wait since `sinceIso`: the rail's number and unit, the long and short
 * forms, and whether it is hot (red at 24 hours, spec 4.1).
 */
export function waitParts(sinceIso, nowMs) {
  const since = Date.parse(sinceIso);
  if (Number.isNaN(since)) return null;
  const mins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((nowMs - since) / 60000));
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  const hot = mins >= HOT_HOURS * 60;
  const tone = hot ? 'danger' : mins >= WARN_HOURS * 60 ? 'warn' : 'info';
  if (mins < 60) {
    return { n: String(mins), unit: 'MIN', long: `${mins} min`, short: `${mins}m`, hot, tone };
  }
  if (hours < 48) {
    let long = `${hours} hrs`;
    if (hours === 1) long = mins % 60 ? `1 hr ${mins % 60} min` : '1 hr';
    return { n: String(hours), unit: hours === 1 ? 'HR' : 'HRS', long, short: `${hours}h`, hot, tone };
  }
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return { n: String(days), unit: 'DAYS', long: `${days} days`, short: `${days}d`, hot, tone };
}

// "Zul's on it", "Dallas is on it" (spec 4.1).
function onItLabel(name) {
  const who = String(name || '').trim() || 'Someone';
  return /s$/i.test(who) ? `${who} is on it` : `${who}'s on it`;
}

/**
 * The one state chip (spec 4.1, in priority order on the server). On an item
 * the viewer opened deliberately, "Not read yet" is no longer true for them,
 * so `deliberate` drops it while the seen write lands.
 */
export function stateChip(state, { deliberate = false } = {}) {
  if (!state || !state.type) return null;
  if (state.type === 'claim') {
    return state.mine ? { kind: 'ok', label: "You're on it" } : { kind: 'info', label: onItLabel(state.by_name) };
  }
  if (state.type === 'promise') {
    return { kind: 'warn', label: state.mine ? "You said you'd follow up" : 'Follow-up promised' };
  }
  if (state.type === 'reopened') return { kind: 'neutral', label: 'Reopened' };
  if (state.type === 'unseen') return deliberate ? null : { kind: 'accent', label: 'Not read yet' };
  return null;
}

/**
 * The line beside the chip on an opened item: who promised and what they
 * said ("You said Monday"), or when a claim was made ("since Mon 11:02 AM").
 */
export function stateNote(state, nowMs) {
  if (!state) return null;
  if (state.type === 'promise' && state.promised_by) {
    if (state.mine) return `You said ${state.promised_by}`;
    if (state.by_name) return `${state.by_name} said ${state.promised_by}`;
    return `Promised ${state.promised_by}`;
  }
  if (state.type === 'claim' && state.since) return `since ${stampLabel(state.since, nowMs)}`;
  return null;
}

/**
 * A moment as the Inbox prints it: "5:41 PM" today, "Wed 8:00 AM" within six
 * days either way, else "Thu Oct 15, 8:00 AM". Chicago time.
 */
export function stampLabel(iso, nowMs) {
  const at = Date.parse(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(at)) return '';
  const day = chicagoDay(new Date(at).toISOString());
  const today = chicagoDay(new Date(nowMs).toISOString());
  const time = chicagoTime(at);
  if (day === today) return time;
  const apart = Math.round((Date.parse(`${day}T12:00:00Z`) - Date.parse(`${today}T12:00:00Z`)) / 86400000);
  if (Math.abs(apart) <= 6) return `${chicagoWeekday(at)} ${time}`;
  return `${chicagoWeekdayDate(at)}, ${time}`;
}

/** "12 min ago", "3 hrs ago", "2 days ago" (the feeds line, spec 4.6). */
export function agoLabel(iso, nowMs) {
  const at = Date.parse(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(at)) return 'never';
  const mins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((nowMs - at) / 60000));
  if (mins < 1) return 'just now';
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins} min ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return hours === 1 ? '1 hr ago' : `${hours} hrs ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return days === 1 ? '1 day ago' : `${days} days ago`;
}

const AI_LINES = {
  off: 'AI read off',
  paused: 'AI read paused at its daily cap',
  failing: 'AI read failing',
};

/**
 * The feeds line (spec 4.6): each source and when it last delivered, a quiet
 * dot at 48 hours (the server's `quiet`), and the AI read's status when it is
 * not on. The hover title carries the Chicago clock time with "CT".
 */
export function feedItems(feeds, ai, nowMs) {
  const items = (feeds || []).map((f) => {
    const name = f.source === 'thumbtack' ? 'Thumbtack' : String(f.source || '');
    return {
      key: `feed-${f.source}`,
      text: `${name} ${f.last_at ? agoLabel(f.last_at, nowMs) : 'never'}`,
      quiet: !!f.quiet,
      title: f.last_at
        ? `${name} last delivered ${chicagoWeekdayDate(f.last_at)}, ${chicagoTime(f.last_at)} CT`
        : `${name} has delivered nothing yet`,
    };
  });
  const status = ai && ai.status;
  if (AI_LINES[status]) items.push({ key: 'ai', text: AI_LINES[status], quiet: true, title: AI_LINES[status] });
  return items;
}

const WHO = {
  D: { label: 'D', cls: 'ib-who ib-who-d', title: 'Dallas' },
  Z: { label: 'Z', cls: 'ib-who ib-who-z', title: 'Zul' },
  AI: { label: 'AI', cls: 'ib-who ib-who-ai', title: 'Closed by the system' },
};

/** Recently handled, grouped by Chicago day, newest first, each row with what
 * they needed beside why it closed (spec 4.5). */
export function handledGroups(rows, nowMs) {
  const sorted = (rows || []).slice().sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.closed_at) - Date.parse(a.closed_at));
  const groups = [];
  for (const r of sorted) {
    const day = chicagoDayLabel(r.closed_at, new Date(nowMs));
    let g = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (!g || g.day !== day) { g = { day, items: [] }; groups.push(g); }
    g.items.push({
      key: r.person_key,
      personKey: r.person_key,
      name: r.name,
      need: r.need || '',
      time: chicagoTime(r.closed_at),
      reason: r.reason_text || '',
      who: WHO[r.by] || null,
      channel: channelLabel(r.channel),
    });
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Snooze presets (spec 4.4): 3 hours; tomorrow 8:00 AM; or a day in the next
 * seven at 8:00 AM, all Chicago. Tomorrow through a week out keeps every pick
 * inside the server's 8-day limit.
 */
export function snoozeOptions(nowMs) {
  const today = chicagoDay(new Date(nowMs).toISOString());
  const three = new Date(nowMs + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const tomorrow = chicagoInstant(addDays(today, 1), 8, 0).toISOString();
  const days = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) => {
    const ymd = addDays(today, i);
    const until = chicagoInstant(ymd, 8, 0).toISOString();
    return {
      key: ymd,
      dow: chicagoWeekday(until).toUpperCase(),
      day: String(Number(ymd.slice(8, 10))),
      until,
      label: `${chicagoWeekdayDate(until)}, 8:00 AM`,
    };
  });
  return {
    presets: [
      { key: '3h', icon: 'clock', label: '3 hours', until: three, when: stampLabel(three, nowMs) },
      { key: 'tomorrow', icon: 'sun', label: 'Tomorrow morning', until: tomorrow, when: `${chicagoWeekday(tomorrow)} 8:00 AM` },
    ],
    days,
  };
}

/** "It's 10:40 PM for them", outside 8 AM to 9 PM Chicago (spec 4.3). */
export function lateNote(nowMs) {
  const hour = chicagoHour(nowMs);
  if (hour === null || (hour >= 8 && hour < 21)) return null;
  return `It's ${chicagoTime(nowMs)} for them`;
}

/** The opted-out notice (spec 4.3); the date is omitted when unknown. */
export function optOutText(optedOut) {
  const since = optedOut && optedOut.since ? chicagoDay(optedOut.since) : '';
  const lead = since ? `Texts are off for this person since ${fmtDate(since)}.` : 'Texts are off for this person.';
  return `${lead} Texts from 888, 1922 or 0082 will not deliver.`;
}

/** "Last good load 2:12 PM CT · 8 were waiting" (spec 4.7). */
export function lastGoodLine(lastGood) {
  if (!lastGood || !lastGood.at) return null;
  const time = chicagoTime(lastGood.at);
  if (!time) return null;
  const n = Number(lastGood.waiting) || 0;
  return `Last good load ${time} CT · ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'was' : 'were'} waiting`;
}

/** Waiting rows, longest wait first (the server sorts; this keeps it so). */
export function sortWaiting(rows) {
  return (rows || []).slice().sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.waiting_since) - Date.parse(b.waiting_since));
}

/** The person the desktop selects on its own: the longest wait, `except` aside. */
export function firstWaitingKey(rows, except) {
  const row = sortWaiting(rows).find((r) => r.person_key !== except);
  return row ? row.person_key : null;
}

/**
 * The claim button (spec 4.4): On it; on your own claim it releases; on
 * someone else's it takes over ("Take over" on the phone, "Take over from
 * Zul" on the desktop, the design's two labels).
 */
export function claimButton(state) {
  if (state && state.type === 'claim' && state.mine) {
    return { action: 'release', label: "You're on it", longLabel: "You're on it", icon: 'check', mine: true, takeoverFrom: null };
  }
  if (state && state.type === 'claim') {
    const who = state.by_name || 'them';
    return { action: 'claim', label: 'Take over', longLabel: `Take over from ${who}`, icon: 'userplus', mine: false, takeoverFrom: state.by_name || null };
  }
  return { action: 'claim', label: 'On it', longLabel: 'On it', icon: 'pin', mine: false, takeoverFrom: null };
}
```

```js
import { chicagoWeekdayDate } from '../../utils/chicagoDay';
import { fmt$, fmtDate } from '../adminos/format';

// The context card's view model, one shape for the phone card and the
// desktop pane (spec section 4.2), from the item payload's `context`, pinned
// by lane inbox-engine. Money arrives in DOLLARS (proposals money), so it goes
// through fmt$ (whole dollars, the dense-view convention). due_date is a DATE
// column: its first ten characters ARE the day (node-pg serialises a DATE as
// the server's local midnight, so a Chicago reading of it would slip a day on
// a UTC server). event_date on a Thumbtack lead is a real instant, so it reads
// on the Chicago calendar.

export const LEGAL_HOLD_TEXT = 'Legal hold: check with Dallas before contacting';
export const NO_QUOTE_TEXT = 'No quote yet. Totals show here once a proposal goes out.';

const PROPOSAL_CHIP_KIND = { Signed: 'ok', Unsigned: 'warn', None: 'neutral' };

/** "Booked · Wedding", "Staff · Bartender", "Thumbtack lead", "Not a client yet". */
export function kindLine(context) {
  const c = context || {};
  if (c.kind === 'client' || c.kind === 'lead') {
    const status = c.status_chip || (c.kind === 'client' ? 'Booked' : 'Lead');
    return c.event_type_label ? `${status} · ${c.event_type_label}` : status;
  }
  if (c.kind === 'staff') return c.role ? `Staff · ${c.role}` : 'Staff';
  if (c.kind === 'tt_lead') return 'Thumbtack lead';
  if (c.kind === 'unknown') return 'Not a client yet';
  return '';
}

function moneyCells(money) {
  if (!money) return null;
  const balance = Number(money.balance) || 0;
  const paid = Number(money.paid) || 0;
  let sub = '';
  if (balance <= 0) sub = 'paid in full';
  else if (money.due_date) sub = `due ${fmtDate(String(money.due_date).slice(0, 10))}`;
  else if (paid === 0) sub = 'no deposit yet';
  return { total: fmt$(money.total), paid: fmt$(money.paid), balance: fmt$(balance), sub, settled: balance <= 0 };
}

function clientModel(c) {
  const status = c.status_chip || (c.kind === 'client' ? 'Booked' : 'Lead');
  const rows = [];
  if (c.when_text) rows.push({ key: 'when', label: 'When', value: c.when_text });
  if (c.where_text) rows.push({ key: 'where', label: 'Where', value: c.where_text });
  // The server words the row, "Not sent yet" with a None chip included.
  if (c.proposal) {
    const chip = c.proposal.chip || null;
    rows.push({
      key: 'proposal', label: 'Proposal', value: c.proposal.status_label || '',
      chip: chip ? { kind: PROPOSAL_CHIP_KIND[chip] || 'neutral', label: chip } : null,
    });
  }
  const l = c.links || {};
  const links = [];
  if (l.client_id) links.push({ key: 'client', label: 'Client', to: `/clients/${l.client_id}` });
  if (l.proposal_id) links.push({ key: 'proposal', label: 'Proposal', to: `/proposals/${l.proposal_id}` });
  if (l.event_id) links.push({ key: 'event', label: 'Event', to: `/events/${l.event_id}` });
  if (!l.proposal_id) {
    links.push({ key: 'new', label: 'New proposal', to: l.client_id ? `/proposals/new?client_id=${l.client_id}` : '/proposals/new' });
  }
  return {
    chip: { kind: status === 'Booked' ? 'ok' : 'info', label: status },
    type: c.event_type_label || '',
    guests: c.guests === null || c.guests === undefined ? null : c.guests,
    rows,
    money: moneyCells(c.money),
    showNoQuote: !c.money,
    links,
  };
}

function staffModel(c) {
  const rows = [];
  const s = c.shift;
  if (s) {
    if (s.when_text) rows.push({ key: 'shift', label: 'Shift', value: s.when_text });
    if (s.event_text) rows.push({ key: 'event', label: 'Event', value: s.event_text });
    const r = s.roster;
    if (r && Number(r.total) > 0) {
      const open = Number(r.total) - Number(r.filled || 0);
      rows.push({
        key: 'roster', label: 'Roster', value: `${Number(r.filled || 0)} of ${Number(r.total)}`,
        chip: open > 0 ? { kind: 'warn', label: `${open} open` } : null,
      });
    }
  } else {
    rows.push({ key: 'shift', label: 'Shift', value: 'No upcoming shift' });
  }
  const l = c.links || {};
  const links = [];
  if (l.user_id) links.push({ key: 'profile', label: 'Staff profile', to: `/staffing/users/${l.user_id}` });
  if (l.shift_id) links.push({ key: 'shift', label: 'Shift', to: `/events/shift/${l.shift_id}` });
  return { chip: { kind: 'neutral', label: 'Staff' }, type: c.role || '', guests: null, rows, money: null, showNoQuote: false, links };
}

function thumbtackModel(c) {
  const rows = [];
  if (c.event_date) rows.push({ key: 'when', label: 'When', value: chicagoWeekdayDate(c.event_date) });
  if (c.location) rows.push({ key: 'where', label: 'Where', value: c.location });
  const links = c.negotiation_id
    ? [{ key: 'tt', label: 'Thumbtack', href: `https://www.thumbtack.com/pro-inbox/messages/${encodeURIComponent(c.negotiation_id)}` }]
    : [];
  return { chip: { kind: 'info', label: 'Lead' }, type: 'Thumbtack', guests: null, rows, money: null, showNoQuote: true, links };
}

function unknownModel(c) {
  return {
    chip: { kind: 'neutral', label: 'Not a client yet' },
    type: c.phone_display || '',
    guests: null,
    rows: [],
    money: null,
    showNoQuote: false,
    links: [{ key: 'new', label: 'New proposal', to: '/proposals/new' }],
  };
}

/** The context card, by kind, with the legal-hold banner when it applies. */
export function contextModel(context, { legalHold = false } = {}) {
  const c = context || {};
  let model = null;
  if (c.kind === 'client' || c.kind === 'lead') model = clientModel(c);
  else if (c.kind === 'staff') model = staffModel(c);
  else if (c.kind === 'tt_lead') model = thumbtackModel(c);
  else if (c.kind === 'unknown') model = unknownModel(c);
  if (!model) return null;
  return { ...model, hold: legalHold ? LEGAL_HOLD_TEXT : null };
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/inboxThread.js`:

```js
import { chicagoDay, chicagoTime, chicagoDayLabel } from '../../utils/chicagoDay';
import { channelLabel, threadChannel } from './inboxFormat';

// The thread's view model (spec section 4.2 Messages): oldest first, a day
// separator whenever the Chicago day changes, each bubble with its channel
// tag, Chicago time and, on our side, its author. System rows carry their
// own copy in `text`, composed by the server for the viewer.

function authorOf(row) {
  if (row.auto) return 'Auto';
  return row.author_name || null;
}

function mediaOf(row) {
  return (row.media || [])
    .filter((m) => m && m.url)
    .map((m, i) => ({
      key: `${row.ref}-m${i}`,
      url: m.url,
      label: /^image\//.test(m.content_type || '') ? 'Photo' : 'Attachment',
    }));
}

export function threadModel(thread, nowMs) {
  const rows = (thread || []).slice().sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.at) - Date.parse(b.at));
  const now = new Date(nowMs);
  const out = [];
  let lastDay = null;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const day = chicagoDay(row.at);
    if (day && day !== lastDay) {
      out.push({ type: 'day', key: `day-${day}`, label: chicagoDayLabel(row.at, now) });
      lastDay = day;
    }
    if (row.direction === 'system') {
      // A proposal send whose email and text both failed is a system line
      // that never arrived: it says so, like a failed bubble.
      out.push({ type: 'sys', key: row.ref, text: row.text || '', failure: row.failed ? (row.failure_reason || 'Not delivered') : null });
      continue;
    }
    const isOut = row.direction === 'out';
    const time = chicagoTime(row.at);
    const author = isOut ? authorOf(row) : null;
    const media = mediaOf(row);
    let body = row.text || '';
    if (!body && media.length === 0) body = '(no text)';
    out.push({
      type: 'msg',
      key: row.ref,
      out: isOut,
      tag: channelLabel(threadChannel(row)),
      meta: [author, time].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      subject: row.subject || null,
      body,
      media,
      relay: row.relay_lead_name ? `Thumbtack relay for ${row.relay_lead_name}` : null,
      failed: isOut && !!row.failed,
      failure: isOut && row.failed ? (row.failure_reason ? `Not delivered: ${row.failure_reason}` : 'Not delivered') : null,
    });
  }
  return out;
}
```

```js
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import api from '../../utils/api';
import useInboxList, { POLL_MS } from './useInboxList';
import useInboxItem from './useInboxItem';
import { readLastGood, resetLastGood } from './lastGood';

jest.mock('../../utils/api', () => ({ __esModule: true, default: { get: jest.fn() } }));

  generated_at: '2026-10-06T19:40:00.000Z', ai: { status: 'on' },
  waiting: [{ person_key: 'c-1', name: 'Avery Example', waiting_since: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z', channels: ['text_888'], state: { type: null } }],
  snoozed: [], handled: [], feeds: [],
};
const fail = () => Promise.reject({ status: 0, code: 'NETWORK_ERROR', message: 'Network error. Check your connection.' });

beforeEach(() => {
  resetLastGood();
  window.localStorage.clear();
});

describe('useInboxList', () => {
  test('loads, then remembers the last good load in memory and storage', async () => {
    api.get.mockResolvedValue({ data: LIST });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useInboxList());
    expect(result.current.status).toBe('loading');
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.status).toBe('ready'));
    expect(result.current.data.waiting).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(api.get).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/admin/inbox');

    expect(JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('drb.inbox.lastGood'))).toMatchObject({ waiting: 1 });
  });

    api.get.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: LIST }).mockImplementation(fail);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useInboxList());
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.status).toBe('ready'));
    await act(async () => { await result.current.refresh(); });
    expect(result.current.status).toBe('error');
    expect(result.current.data).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.lastGood).toMatchObject({ waiting: 1 });
  });

  test('a first load that fails reads the last good load from storage', async () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem('drb.inbox.lastGood', JSON.stringify({ at: '2026-10-06T19:12:00.000Z', waiting: 8 }));
    api.get.mockImplementation(fail);

    api.get.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: LIST }).mockImplementation(fail);

    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.status).toBe('ready'));

    expect(result.current.lastGood).toMatchObject({ waiting: 1 });

  });
});

describe('useInboxItem', () => {
```

```js
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import useInboxDrafts from './useInboxDrafts';
import { newSendId } from './sendId';

const UUID_V4 = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

test('drafts are kept per person and survive any number of re-renders', () => {
  const { result, rerender } = renderHook(() => useInboxDrafts());
  act(() => { result.current.setText('c-1', 'See you at six'); });
  act(() => { result.current.setText('s-2', 'Can you cover?'); });
  act(() => { result.current.setLine('c-1', '1922'); });
  rerender();
  rerender();
  expect(result.current.draftOf('c-1')).toMatchObject({ text: 'See you at six', line: '1922' });
  expect(result.current.draftOf('s-2').text).toBe('Can you cover?');
  expect(result.current.draftOf('c-9')).toEqual({ text: '', line: null, sendId: null });
});

test('a send id is minted once per attempt and reused until the server answers', () => {
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useInboxDrafts());
  let first;
  let again;
  act(() => { first = result.current.sendIdFor('c-1'); });
  act(() => { again = result.current.sendIdFor('c-1'); });
  expect(first).toMatch(UUID_V4);
  expect(again).toBe(first);
  // The server answered: that id is spent, the next tap is a new attempt.
  let next;
  act(() => { result.current.spend('c-1'); });
  act(() => { next = result.current.sendIdFor('c-1'); });
  expect(next).toMatch(UUID_V4);
  expect(next).not.toBe(first);
});

test('clear empties the text and spends the id, and leaves other people alone', () => {
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useInboxDrafts());
  act(() => { result.current.setText('c-1', 'Sent this'); result.current.setText('c-2', 'Still typing'); });
  let id;
  act(() => { id = result.current.sendIdFor('c-1'); });
  act(() => { result.current.clear('c-1'); });
  expect(result.current.draftOf('c-1')).toMatchObject({ text: '', sendId: null });
  expect(result.current.draftOf('c-2').text).toBe('Still typing');
  let fresh;
  act(() => { fresh = result.current.sendIdFor('c-1'); });
  expect(fresh).not.toBe(id);
});

test('the send id is a v4 UUID with or without crypto.randomUUID', () => {
  const saved = window.crypto;
  try {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'crypto', { value: undefined, configurable: true });
    const ids = new Set(Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => newSendId()));
    ids.forEach((id) => expect(id).toMatch(UUID_V4));
    expect(ids.size).toBe(50);

    expect(newSendId()).toBe('11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555');
```

```js
import api from '../../utils/api';

// Every Inbox call, through utils/api.js (spec section 10), against lane
// inbox-engine's routes (spec section 8). Person keys are URL-safe by their
// pattern; encodeURIComponent is belt and braces.
const enc = (key) => encodeURIComponent(String(key));

export const getInbox = () => api.get('/admin/inbox');

// A 404 RESOLVES here instead of rejecting: its body carries the moved_to
// hint (INBOX_MOVED), and utils/api.js keeps only message, code and status
// when it rejects.
export const getItem = (key) => api.get(`/admin/inbox/${enc(key)}`, {
  validateStatus: (s) => (s >= 200 && s < 300) || s === 404,
});

export const postSeen = (key) => api.post(`/admin/inbox/${enc(key)}/seen`);

export const postAction = (key, action, until) => api.post(
  `/admin/inbox/${enc(key)}/actions`,
  until ? { action, until } : { action }
);

export const undoAction = (id) => api.delete(`/admin/inbox/actions/${enc(id)}`);

export const sendText = (key, { body, line, sendId }) => api.post(
  `/admin/inbox/${enc(key)}/text`,
  { body, line, send_id: sendId }
);
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/lastGood.js`:

```js
// The last good list load (spec 4.7 and 10): when it landed and how many were
// waiting, for the error card's "Last good load 2:12 PM CT · 8 were waiting".
// Kept in memory and in localStorage; storage can be blocked (private
// windows, cleared site data), so every access is guarded and memory wins.
const KEY = 'drb.inbox.lastGood';
let memory = null;

export function rememberLastGood(waiting, atIso) {
  memory = { at: atIso, waiting: Number(waiting) || 0 };
  try { window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(memory)); } catch { /* memory still holds it */ }
}

export function readLastGood() {
  if (memory) return memory;
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null');
    if (v && typeof v.at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Number(v.waiting))) return { at: v.at, waiting: Number(v.waiting) };
  } catch { /* unreadable: there is no last good load to show */ }
  return null;
}

// For tests: forget the in-memory copy (storage is the test's to clear).
export function resetLastGood() {
  memory = null;
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/sendId.js`:

```js
// A send id is a version 4 UUID (spec section 8: send_id is a client-generated
// UUID). It only has to be unique per attempt, never secret, so the last
// fallback is Math.random.
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

export function newSendId() {
  const c = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.crypto : null;
  if (c && typeof c.randomUUID === 'function') return c.randomUUID();
  let bytes;
  if (c && typeof c.getRandomValues === 'function') bytes = c.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
  else bytes = Uint8Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const h = hex(bytes);
  return `${h.slice(0, 8)}-${h.slice(8, 12)}-${h.slice(12, 16)}-${h.slice(16, 20)}-${h.slice(20)}`;
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/useInboxList.js`:

```js
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { getInbox } from './inboxApi';
import { readLastGood, rememberLastGood } from './lastGood';

export const POLL_MS = 60000;

// The Inbox list (spec 4.1, 4.7 and 10): GET /admin/inbox on mount, every 60 s
// while the tab is visible, and the moment the tab comes back into view, like
// the badge counts. `status` is 'loading' only until the first answer. A
// failed load is 'error' with NO data, whatever was on screen before: an
// error never renders as an empty (or a stale) list. The page shows the error
// card with the last good load instead. Only the newest request may answer.
export default function useInboxList() {
  const [state, setState] = useState({ status: 'loading', data: null, pending: true });
  const seq = useRef(0);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    seq.current += 1;
    const mine = seq.current;
    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, pending: true }));
    return getInbox()
      .then((res) => {
        if (!alive.current || mine !== seq.current) return;
        const data = res.data || {};
        rememberLastGood((data.waiting || []).length, new Date().toISOString());
        setState({ status: 'ready', data, pending: false });
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!alive.current || mine !== seq.current) return;
        setState({ status: 'error', data: null, pending: false });
      });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    load();
    const tick = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load(); }, POLL_MS);
    const onVisible = () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load(); };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      clearInterval(tick);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    };
  }, [load]);

  return {
    status: state.status,
    data: state.data,
    pending: state.pending,
    lastGood: state.status === 'error' ? readLastGood() : null,
    refresh: load,
  };
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/useInboxItem.js`:

```js
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { getItem } from './inboxApi';
import { isPersonKey } from './inboxFormat';
import { POLL_MS } from './useInboxList';

const IDLE = { key: null, status: 'idle', data: null, movedTo: null, refreshFailed: false };

// One person's item (spec 4.2): GET /admin/inbox/:personKey when the key
// changes, every 60 s while visible, and when the tab comes back. Statuses:
//   idle      no key
//   loading   first read for this key (nothing of another person is kept)
//   ready     data for this key
//   moved     404 INBOX_MOVED with a valid moved_to: the caller follows it
//   gone      404 with no hint, a key that is not a person key at all, or a
//             400 (the server refused the key itself: no retry can fix it)
//   error     the first read failed (a later failed poll keeps the data on
//             screen and sets refreshFailed, so a flaky poll never yanks the
//             composer away mid-sentence)
export default function useInboxItem(personKey) {
  const [state, setState] = useState(IDLE);
  const seq = useRef(0);
  const keyRef = useRef(personKey);
  keyRef.current = personKey;

  const load = useCallback((key) => {
    if (!key) { setState(IDLE); return Promise.resolve(); }
    if (!isPersonKey(key)) { setState({ ...IDLE, key, status: 'gone' }); return Promise.resolve(); }
    seq.current += 1;
    const mine = seq.current;
    const current = () => mine === seq.current && keyRef.current === key;
    return getItem(key)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!current()) return;
        if (res.status === 404) {
          const body = res.data || {};
          const movedTo = body.code === 'INBOX_MOVED' && isPersonKey(body.moved_to) ? body.moved_to : null;
          setState({ ...IDLE, key, status: movedTo ? 'moved' : 'gone', movedTo });
          return;
        }
        setState({ key, status: 'ready', data: res.data, movedTo: null, refreshFailed: false });
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!current()) return;
        if (err && err.status === 400) { setState({ ...IDLE, key, status: 'gone' }); return; }
        setState((prev) => (prev.key === key && prev.data
          ? { ...prev, refreshFailed: true }
          : { ...IDLE, key, status: 'error' }));
      });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // A different person: clear first, so nothing of the last one renders.
    setState(personKey ? { ...IDLE, key: personKey, status: 'loading' } : IDLE);
    load(personKey);
    if (!personKey) return undefined;
    const tick = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load(personKey); }, POLL_MS);
    const onVisible = () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load(personKey); };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(tick);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    };
  }, [personKey, load]);

  const refresh = useCallback(() => load(keyRef.current), [load]);
  // A render between the key changing and the effect clearing must not show
  // the previous person: only state for THIS key counts.
  const mineNow = state.key === personKey ? state : { ...IDLE, key: personKey, status: personKey ? 'loading' : 'idle' };
  return { ...mineNow, refresh };
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/useInboxDrafts.js`:

```js
import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { newSendId } from './sendId';

const EMPTY = { text: '', line: null, sendId: null };

// Drafts, keyed by person (spec 4.3 and 10): the text, the chosen FROM line,
// and the send id. The page holds them ABOVE its phone/desktop fork, so a
// poll, a refetch, or opening someone else never touches a draft.
//
// The send id: minted on the first tap of an attempt and reused by every
// retry until the server settles that attempt (ReplyBar decides: no answer,
// or "still sending", keeps it), so a double tap or a retry can never text
// twice. Once the server has settled an attempt it answers that id the same
// way forever, so spend() drops it and the next tap is a new attempt.
export default function useInboxDrafts() {
  const store = useRef({});
  const [, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const bump = useCallback(() => setVersion((v) => v + 1), []);

  const put = useCallback((key, patch) => {
    store.current = { ...store.current, [key]: { ...EMPTY, ...store.current[key], ...patch } };
    bump();
  }, [bump]);

  const draftOf = useCallback((key) => store.current[key] || EMPTY, []);
  const setText = useCallback((key, text) => put(key, { text }), [put]);
  const setLine = useCallback((key, line) => put(key, { line }), [put]);
  const sendIdFor = useCallback((key) => {
    const cur = store.current[key];
    if (cur && cur.sendId) return cur.sendId;
    const id = newSendId();
    put(key, { sendId: id });
    return id;
  }, [put]);
  const spend = useCallback((key) => put(key, { sendId: null }), [put]);
  const clear = useCallback((key) => put(key, { text: '', sendId: null }), [put]);

  // One stable object: the owner re-renders on every change (the version
  // bump) and passes it down, so effects that take it never re-run per key.
  return useMemo(
    () => ({ draftOf, setText, setLine, sendIdFor, spend, clear }),
    [draftOf, setText, setLine, sendIdFor, spend, clear]
  );
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/useInboxActions.js`:

```js
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '../../context/ToastContext';
import { postAction, postSeen, undoAction } from './inboxApi';
import { stampLabel, UNDO_TOAST_MS } from './inboxFormat';

// The taps (spec 4.4): On it, Done, Snooze, Wake, Reopen, plus the seen write
// of a deliberate open (spec 4.2). After each the page refetches what it
// shows and refreshes the badges (spec 10), through `refresh`. Done, Snooze,
// Wake and Reopen toast with Undo for about 4 seconds; Undo calls the DELETE
// route, which marks the action undone and never deletes it. Claim and
// release toast without Undo (tapping again is the undo).
export default function useInboxActions({ refresh }) {
  const toast = useToast();

  const undo = useCallback(async (id) => {
    try {
      await undoAction(id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error((err && err.message) || "Couldn't undo that.");
    }
    refresh();
  }, [toast, refresh]);

  const act = useCallback(async (personKey, action, { until, name, takeoverFrom } = {}) => {
    let res;
    try {
      res = await postAction(personKey, action, until);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error((err && err.message) || "Couldn't save that. Try again.");
      refresh();
      return false;
    }
    const id = res && res.data ? res.data.id : null;
    const withUndo = id === null || id === undefined
      ? undefined
      : { action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => undo(id) }, duration: UNDO_TOAST_MS };
    if (action === 'done') toast.success('Done. Moved to Handled.', withUndo);
    else if (action === 'snooze') toast.info(`Snoozed until ${stampLabel(until, Date.now())}.`, withUndo);
    else if (action === 'wake' || action === 'reopen') toast.info(`${name || 'They'} ${name ? 'is' : 'are'} back in Waiting.`, withUndo);
    else if (action === 'claim') toast.success(takeoverFrom ? `Taken over from ${takeoverFrom}.` : "You're on it.");
    else if (action === 'release') toast.info('Released. Back to unclaimed.');
    refresh();
    return true;
  }, [toast, refresh, undo]);

  // Best effort: a seen write that fails leaves "Not read yet" up for the
  // other person, which is the safe direction.
  const markSeen = useCallback(
    (personKey) => postSeen(personKey).then(() => refresh({ item: false })).catch(() => {}),
    [refresh]
  );

  return useMemo(() => ({ act, undo, markSeen }), [act, undo, markSeen]);
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/useNow.js`:

```js
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

// The Inbox's clock: Date.now(), refreshed every `everyMs`, so a wait ticks
// from 46 to 47 hrs and the late-hours note appears without a reload.
export default function useNow(everyMs = 30000) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), everyMs);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [everyMs]);
  return now;
}
```

Create `client/src/utils/toastCss.test.js` (the toast's scope):

```js
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

// Pins the Inbox toast (spec 2026-10-06, amendment 24). Its House Lights
// edges (square, jewel-tone) and its phone placement under the header apply
// only while Inbox is open; every other admin page keeps today's toast. So a
// rule for the toast box or its container, past the shipped ones below, must
// be scoped to an open Inbox: :has(.ib-page) on the desktop, :has(.ib-phone)
// on the phone. The buttons inside a toast (.toast-action, .toast-dismiss)
// are not the box and are not checked.

const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../index.css'), 'utf8');

const SHIPPED = [
  '.toast-container', '.toast', '.toast-success', '.toast-error', '.toast-info',
  'html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast', 'html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast-success',
  'html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast-error', 'html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast-info',
];
const TOAST_BOX = /^\.toast(?:-container|-success|-error|-info)?(?=$|[.:[])/;
const INBOX_OPEN = /:has\(\.ib-(?:page|phone)\)/;

// Comments stripped first, and the opening of every block at-rule but
// @keyframes unwrapped, so a rule inside a media query is still a rule.
const selectorsOf = (text) => text.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
  .replace(/@(?!keyframes)[a-z-]+[^{;]*\{/g, '').replace(/@[a-z-]+[^{;]*;/g, '')
  .split('}').map((chunk) => chunk.split('{')[0].trim())
  .filter((s) => s && !s.startsWith('@') && !/^(from|to|\d+%)/.test(s))
  .flatMap((s) => s.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()));
const lastCompound = (selector) => selector.split(/[\s>+~]+/).pop();
const looseToastSelectors = (text) => selectorsOf(text)
  .filter((s) => TOAST_BOX.test(lastCompound(s)) && !SHIPPED.includes(s) && !INBOX_OPEN.test(s));

test('past the shipped rules, every rule for the toast box or its container is scoped to an open Inbox', () => {
  expect(looseToastSelectors(css)).toEqual([]);
});

test('the Inbox toast: square House Lights edges on both shells, under the header on the phone', () => {
  expect(selectorsOf(css)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
    'html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-page) .toast',
    'html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast',
    'html[data-app="admin-os"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast-container',
  ]));
});

test('the scope check sees an unscoped rule, inside a media query too, and skips the buttons', () => {
  expect(looseToastSelectors('html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"] .toast { border-radius: 0; }'))
    .toEqual(['html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"] .toast']);
  expect(looseToastSelectors('@media (max-width: 600px) {\n  html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast-container { top: 66px; }\n}'))
    .toEqual(['html[data-app="admin-os"] .toast-container']);
  expect(looseToastSelectors('/* note */\nhtml[data-app="admin-os"] .toast .toast-action { color: red; }')).toEqual([]);
});
```

```js
import React from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import StatusChip from '../adminos/StatusChip';
import { channelIcon, channelLabel, stampLabel, stateChip, waitParts } from './inboxFormat';

// One waiting person (spec 4.1 and 11). The phone card is the shipped m-card
// with its rail as the wait (big number over a unit, red at 24 hours); the
// desktop row follows the Needs-attention queue (queue-icon, toned by the
// wait). Each is one tap target that opens the person deliberately.

const NO_WAIT = { n: '', unit: '', short: '', hot: false, tone: 'info' };

export function WaitingCard({ row, nowMs, onOpen }) {
  const wait = waitParts(row.waiting_since, nowMs) || NO_WAIT;
  const chip = stateChip(row.state);
  return (
    <button type="button" className="m-card" onClick={() => onOpen(row.person_key)}>
      <span className={wait.hot ? 'm-rail ib-rail-hot' : 'm-rail'}>
        <span className="m-rail-day">{wait.n}</span>
        <span className="m-rail-mon">{wait.unit}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="m-card-body">
        <span className="m-card-head">
          <span className="m-card-title">{row.name}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="ib-need">{row.need}</span>
        <span className="m-card-foot">
          {chip && <StatusChip kind={chip.kind}>{chip.label}</StatusChip>}
          <span className="m-tags">
            {(row.channels || []).map((c) => <span key={c} className="m-tag">{channelLabel(c)}</span>)}
          </span>
        </span>
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

export function WaitingRow({ row, nowMs, selected, onOpen }) {
  const wait = waitParts(row.waiting_since, nowMs) || NO_WAIT;
  const chip = stateChip(row.state);
  const channels = row.channels || [];
  const open = () => onOpen(row.person_key);
  return (
    <div
      className={selected ? 'ib-drow is-selected' : 'ib-drow'}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-current={selected ? 'true' : undefined}
      onClick={open}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open(); } }}
    >
      {/* The icon is the person's latest channel, toned by the wait. */}
      <div className={`queue-icon ${wait.tone} ib-drow-icon`} aria-hidden="true">
        <Icon name={channelIcon(channels[channels.length - 1])} />
      </div>
      <div className="ib-drow-main">
        <div className="ib-drow-head">
          <span className="ib-drow-name">{row.name}</span>
          <span className={wait.hot ? 'ib-drow-wait ib-hot' : 'ib-drow-wait'}>{wait.short}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="ib-drow-need">{row.need}</div>
        <div className="ib-drow-foot">
          {chip && <StatusChip kind={chip.kind}>{chip.label}</StatusChip>}
          <span className="ib-tags">
            {channels.map((c) => <span key={c} className="ib-tag">{channelLabel(c)}</span>)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// "<name> snoozed until Wed 8:00 AM" with Wake (spec 4.1, the design).
export function SnoozedRow({ row, nowMs, onWake, variant = 'phone' }) {
  const until = stampLabel(row.until, nowMs);
  if (variant === 'desktop') {
    return (
      <div className="ib-dsnz">
        <Icon name="clock" size={12} />
        <span className="ib-dsnz-text">{row.name} snoozed until <span className="ib-num">{until}</span></span>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => onWake(row)}>Wake</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="ib-snz">
      <span className="ib-snz-icon" aria-hidden="true"><Icon name="clock" size={14} /></span>
      <span className="ib-snz-text">{row.name} snoozed until <span className="ib-num">{until}</span></span>
      <button type="button" className="m-fail-retry" onClick={() => onWake(row)}>Wake</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/HandledList.js`:

```js
import React from 'react';
import { handledGroups } from './inboxFormat';

// Recently handled (spec 4.5): the last 7 days by Chicago day, newest first,
// each row with what they needed, the reason, who (D, Z, or a dashed AI mark;
// Thumbtack has none) and Reopen. The need line is spec 4.5's; the design
// drew the row without it, and beside an "AI: ..." reason it is what lets
// Dallas judge the AI's call.

function Who({ who, wide }) {
  if (!who) return null;
  return <span className={wide ? `${who.cls} ib-who-wide` : who.cls} title={who.title} aria-hidden="true">{who.label}</span>;
}

export default function HandledList({ rows, nowMs, onReopen, variant = 'phone' }) {
  const groups = handledGroups(rows, nowMs);
  if (variant === 'desktop') {
    if (groups.length === 0) return <div className="ib-dnote">Nothing closed in the last 7 days.</div>;
    return groups.map((g) => (
      <React.Fragment key={g.day}>
        <div className="ib-dhgroup">{g.day}</div>
        {g.items.map((h) => (
          <div key={h.key} className="ib-dhrow">
            <Who who={h.who} wide />
            <div className="ib-dhrow-main">
              <div className="ib-dhrow-head">
                <span className="ib-dhrow-name">{h.name}</span>
                <span className="ib-dhrow-time">{h.time}</span>
              </div>
              {h.need && <div className="ib-dhrow-need">{h.need}</div>}
              <div className="ib-dhrow-why">
                {h.reason} <span className="ib-dhrow-dot" aria-hidden="true">·</span> <span className="ib-dhrow-ch">{h.channel}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onClick={() => onReopen(h)}>Reopen</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </React.Fragment>
    ));
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="ib-handled-intro">Closed in the last 7 days, and why. Reopen puts it back in Waiting.</div>
      {groups.length === 0 && (
        <div className="m-empty">
          <div className="m-empty-body">Nothing closed in the last 7 days.</div>
        </div>
      )}
      {groups.map((g) => (
        <section key={g.day} className="ib-hgroup">
          <h2 className="m-more-heading">{g.day}</h2>
          <ul className="m-more-list">
            {g.items.map((h) => (
              <li key={h.key} className="ib-hrow">
                <span className="ib-hrow-main">
                  <span className="ib-hrow-head">
                    <span className="ib-hrow-name">{h.name}</span>
                    <span className="ib-hrow-time">{h.time}</span>
                  </span>
                  {h.need && <span className="ib-hrow-need">{h.need}</span>}
                  <span className="ib-hrow-why">
                    <Who who={h.who} />
                    <span className="ib-hrow-reason">{h.reason}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="ib-hrow-ch"><span className="m-tag">{h.channel}</span></span>
                </span>
                <button type="button" className="m-fail-retry ib-on-card" onClick={() => onReopen(h)}>Reopen</button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/FeedsLine.js`:

```js
import React from 'react';
import { feedItems } from './inboxFormat';

// The feeds line that closes the list (spec 4.6): when each source last
// delivered, a quiet dot at 48 hours (information, not an alarm), and the AI
// read's status when it is not on. While the list has not loaded, the feeds
// are unknown and the line says so instead of guessing.
export default function FeedsLine({ feeds, ai, nowMs, failed = false, variant = 'phone' }) {
  const items = failed
    ? [{ key: 'unknown', text: 'Feed status unknown until the inbox loads', quiet: true, title: '' }]
    : feedItems(feeds, ai, nowMs);
  return (
    <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-feeds ib-feeds-pane' : 'ib-feeds'}>
      <span className="ib-feeds-label">Feeds</span>
      {items.map((f, i) => (
        <span key={f.key} className={f.quiet ? 'ib-feed ib-feed-quiet' : 'ib-feed'} title={f.title || undefined}>
          {f.quiet && <span className="ib-feed-dot" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <span>{f.text}</span>
          {i < items.length - 1 && <span className="ib-feed-sep" aria-hidden="true">·</span>}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```js
import React from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import { lastGoodLine } from './inboxFormat';

// The list's three states (spec 4.7): loading (first load only), empty, and
// the error card, which says outright that it is not an empty inbox.

const SKELETONS = [['62%', '44%'], ['70%', '38%'], ['55%', '46%'], ['66%', '40%']];
const EMPTY_TITLE = "Nobody's waiting";
const EMPTY_BODY = 'Everyone has a reply. New messages land here the moment a feed delivers them.';

export function ListLoading({ variant = 'phone' }) {
  if (variant === 'desktop') {
    return (
      <div role="status" aria-label="Loading the inbox">
        <div className="ib-skel-note">first sync · fetching the inbox</div>
        {SKELETONS.map(([w1, w2]) => (
          <div key={w1} className="ib-dskel" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="ib-dskel-icon" />
            <span className="ib-dskel-bars">
              <span className="ib-dskel-bar" style={{ width: w1 }} />
              <span className="ib-dskel-bar ib-dskel-thin" style={{ width: w2 }} />
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div role="status" aria-label="Loading the inbox">
      <div className="m-skel-note">first sync · fetching the inbox</div>
      {SKELETONS.map(([w1, w2]) => (
        <div key={w1} className="m-card m-card-skel" aria-hidden="true">
          <span className="m-skel-rail" />
          <span className="m-card-body ib-skel-body">
            <span className="m-skel-bar" style={{ width: w1 }} />
            <span className="m-skel-bar thin" style={{ width: w2 }} />
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ListEmpty({ variant = 'phone' }) {
  return (
    <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty' : 'm-empty ok'}>
      <Icon name="check" size={28} />
      <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty-title' : 'm-empty-title'}>{EMPTY_TITLE}</div>
      <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty-body' : 'm-empty-body'}>{EMPTY_BODY}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

// The red-bordered error card. The list's copy says outright that it is not
// an empty inbox; an item that fails to load gets the same card (spec 4.2).
export function ErrorCard({ title, body, last, onRetry, pending, variant = 'phone' }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-error ib-error-pane' : 'ib-error'} role="alert">
        <span className="ib-error-icon"><Icon name="alert" size={28} /></span>
        <div className="ib-error-title">{title}</div>
        <div className="ib-error-body">{body}</div>
        {last && <div className="ib-error-last">{last}</div>}
        <button
          type="button"
          className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'btn btn-primary ib-error-retry' : 'm-retry-btn ib-error-retry'}
          onClick={onRetry}
          disabled={pending}
        >
          {pending ? 'Retrying' : 'Retry'}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="ib-error-hint">Check your connection or try again.</div>
    </>
  );
}

export function ListError({ lastGood, onRetry, pending, variant = 'phone' }) {
  return (
    <ErrorCard
      variant={variant}
      title="Couldn't load the inbox"
      body="This is not an empty inbox. People may still be waiting; the list just didn't arrive."
      last={lastGoodLine(lastGood)}
      onRetry={onRetry}
      pending={pending}
    />
  );
}

// An opened item's first read (spec 4.2 Loading: a skeleton).
export function ItemLoading({ variant = 'phone' }) {
  const bar = variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dskel-bar' : 'm-skel-bar';
  return (
    <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-item-skel ib-item-skel-desk' : 'ib-item-skel'} role="status" aria-label="Loading the conversation">
      <span className={bar} style={{ width: '38%' }} />
      <span className={bar} style={{ width: '64%' }} />
      <span className={bar} style={{ width: '52%' }} />
    </div>
  );
}

// A key that no longer resolves (spec 4.2 Gone). With a hint the page has
// already followed it; this is the no-hint case.
export function ItemGone({ onBack, variant = 'phone' }) {
  return (
    <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty' : 'm-empty'}>
      <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty-title' : 'm-empty-title'}>This conversation moved</div>
      <div className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'ib-dempty-body' : 'm-empty-body'}>It may belong to another person now. Find them in the list.</div>
      <button type="button" className={variant === 'desktop' ? 'btn btn-secondary' : 'm-retry-btn'} onClick={onBack}>Back to Inbox</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Inbox (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-inbox-design.md section 11;
   design docs/design-artifacts/2026-10-06-inbox/). The phone reuses the
   shipped m-* rules (card, rail, tags, seg, sheet, acts, header) and adds
   ib-* for what they lack; the desktop follows the Needs-attention queue
   and the Messages thread. Per-skin values with no index.css token live in
   the --ib-* tokens below, lifted from the design's tok() tables. Red is the
   literal #ff4d4d on After Hours: that palette sets the danger hue to violet
   inline, so a computed danger colour reads purple (the m-* block's law).
   ========================================================================== */
html[data-app="admin-os"] {
  --ib-hot: #ff4d4d;
  --ib-fail-line: rgba(255, 77, 77, 0.6);
  --ib-warn-ink: hsl(var(--warn-h) var(--warn-s) 58%);
  --ib-ok-ink: hsl(var(--ok-h) var(--ok-s) 52%);
  --ib-stale-dot: hsl(var(--warn-h) var(--warn-s) 52%);
  --ib-zul-bg: hsl(var(--info-h) var(--info-s) 52% / 0.16);
  --ib-ai-line: var(--line-3);
  --ib-link: hsl(var(--accent-h) var(--accent-s) 62%);
  --ib-on-accent: #fff;
  --ib-r: var(--radius);
  --ib-r-sm: var(--radius-sm);
  --ib-r-lg: var(--radius-lg);
  --ib-pill: 999px;
}
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"] {
  --ib-hot: var(--ms-bordeaux);
  --ib-fail-line: var(--ms-bordeaux);
  --ib-warn-ink: hsl(38 63% 30%);
  --ib-ok-ink: var(--ms-emerald);
  --ib-stale-dot: var(--ms-camel);
  --ib-zul-bg: hsl(var(--info-h) var(--info-s) 36% / 0.1);
  --ib-ai-line: var(--ink-4);
  --ib-link: var(--accent);
  --ib-on-accent: var(--bg-0);
  --ib-r: 0;
  --ib-r-sm: 0;
  --ib-r-lg: 0;
  --ib-pill: 0;
}
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-num { font-family: var(--font-numeric); }
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-hot { color: var(--ib-hot); }

/* ---- The toast while Inbox is open, and only then (spec amendment 24; every
   other page keeps today's toast, pinned by utils/toastCss.test.js): House
   Lights squares it and paints its edges with the jewel tones, and on the
   phone it sits under the header, full width, where the design draws it, so
   it never covers Back or Search. .ib-page is the desktop root; .ib-phone
   wraps the phone Inbox and draws no box of its own. */
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-phone { display: contents; }
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-page) .toast,
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast { border-radius: 0; }
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-page) .toast-success,
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast-success { border-left-color: var(--ms-emerald); }
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-page) .toast-info,
html[data-app="admin-os"][data-skin="light"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast-info { border-left-color: var(--ms-navy); }
html[data-app="admin-os"]:has(.ib-phone) .toast-container {
  top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 66px);
  left: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  max-width: none;
}

/* ---- Desktop page: header, then three panes (1440 frame: 360 / 1fr / 280) */
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-page {
  height: 100%; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.25rem;
}
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-grid {
  flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: grid; gap: var(--gap);
  grid-template-columns: 360px minmax(0, 1fr) 280px;
}
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-ctx-pane { overflow-y: auto; }
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-thread-pane { position: relative; }
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-pane-scroll { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; }
/* Links styled as .btn (context links, Open in Thumbtack): the legacy public
   .btn paints IM Fell on an anchor; admin buttons escape it through the
   button reset, links do not. */
html[data-app="admin-os"] .ib-pane a.btn { font-family: var(--font-ui); }
/* Narrower desktops: the context pane drops under the thread. */
@media (max-width: 1279px) {

html[data-app="admin-os"] .m-fail-retry.ib-on-card { background: var(--bg-1); }
```

### Task 28: The item's pieces: thread, context, actions, snooze, reply

**Files:**
- Create: `client/src/components/inbox/Thread.js`, `ContextViews.js`, `ItemActions.js`, `SnoozePickers.js`, `ReplyBar.js`, `ReplyBar.test.js`, `inboxItemViews.test.js`
- Modify: `client/src/index.css` (append part B after part A)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 24 to 27.
- Produces: default `Thread({ items, variant })`; `ContextCard({ model })` (phone), `ContextPane({ model })` (desktop); `PhoneActions({ state, busy, onClaim, onSnooze, onDone })`, `DesktopActions({ state, busy, nowMs, onClaim, onSnooze(untilIso), onDone })`, `ItemBanner({ item, nowMs, busy, onWake, onReopen, variant })`; `SnoozeSheet({ name, nowMs, onPick(untilIso), onClose })`, `SnoozeMenu({ nowMs, onPick, onClose })`; default `ReplyBar({ personKey, name, reply, drafts, nowMs, onSent, variant })`. `onClaim` receives `claimButton(state)` (`{ action: 'claim'|'release', takeoverFrom }`).

Behavior pinned here (spec 4.3, amendment 3): Send is disabled in flight, and two taps in one burst post once (the in-flight ref holds before the disabled button renders); a send with no answer keeps the draft and every retry reuses its `send_id`, through a 409 `INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS` ("Still sending, check the thread.") and a 429 with no code alike; a send the server answered with a failure keeps the draft and the next tap carries a new `send_id`; a 201 carrying a failed row is not a success; the FROM hint names `their_line` and is absent when that is null; the success toast is "Sent from 1922." with NO action (decision 30); opted out replaces the box with the notice and keeps another channel's Open button; a bad number cannot be texted; staff get the staff-line caption and the 888; the first text from a 224 line shows its prefix; outside 8 AM to 9 PM Chicago the composer warns.

```js
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import api from '../../utils/api';
import ReplyBar from './ReplyBar';
import useInboxDrafts from './useInboxDrafts';

jest.mock('../../utils/api', () => ({ __esModule: true, default: { post: jest.fn() } }));
// A stable toast double (CRA resetMocks wipes jest.fn implementations, so the
// calls are recorded by hand).
const mockToasts = [];
jest.mock('../../context/ToastContext', () => ({
  useToast: () => ({
    success: (m, o) => mockToasts.push({ type: 'success', m, o }),
    error: (m, o) => mockToasts.push({ type: 'error', m, o }),
    info: (m, o) => mockToasts.push({ type: 'info', m, o }),
  }),
}));

// Tue Oct 6 2026, 2:40 PM Chicago: inside texting hours.
const NOW = Date.parse('2026-10-06T19:40:00.000Z');
const TEXT_REPLY = {
  mode: 'text', lines: ['888', '1922'], default_line: '1922', last_line: '1922', their_line: '1922',
  recipient_display: '(312) 555-0148', opted_out: null, bad_number: false,
  proxy: false, staff: false, first_text_prefix: {}, app: null,
};

function setup(reply = TEXT_REPLY, { onSent = () => {}, nowMs = NOW, variant = 'phone' } = {}) {
  const { result: drafts } = renderHook(() => useInboxDrafts());
  const view = render(<ReplyBar personKey="c-7" name="Avery Example" reply={reply} drafts={drafts.current} nowMs={nowMs} onSent={onSent} variant={variant} />);
  const rerender = () => view.rerender(<ReplyBar personKey="c-7" name="Avery Example" reply={reply} drafts={drafts.current} nowMs={nowMs} onSent={onSent} variant={variant} />);
  return { drafts, rerender };
}
const box = () => screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' });
const type = (text, rerender) => { fireEvent.change(box(), { target: { value: text } }); rerender(); };
const sentIds = () => api.post.mock.calls.map(([, body]) => body.send_id);
// Tap Send and wait for its toast (the nth of the test).
const tapSend = async (n, rerender) => {
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(mockToasts).toHaveLength(n));
  rerender();
};

beforeEach(() => { mockToasts.length = 0; });

test('the FROM switch offers the enabled lines on the default line, with "last texted"', () => {
  setup();
  expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '1922' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
  expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '888' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
  expect(screen.getByText('last texted 1922')).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(box()).toHaveAttribute('placeholder', 'Text Avery from 1922');
});

test('switching away from the line they texted warns, and the draft keeps the choice', () => {
  const { rerender, drafts } = setup();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '888' }));
  rerender();
  expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '888' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
  expect(screen.getByText('they texted 1922')).toHaveClass('ib-from-warn');
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').line).toBe('888');
});

test('the hint names their_line, the line THEY last texted, even when our last text went from another line', () => {
  setup({ ...TEXT_REPLY, default_line: '888', last_line: '888', their_line: '1922' });
  expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '888' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
  expect(screen.getByText('they texted 1922')).toHaveClass('ib-from-warn');
  expect(screen.queryByText('last texted 888')).toBeNull();
});

test('no hint for someone who has never texted a DRB line (their_line null)', () => {
  setup({ ...TEXT_REPLY, their_line: null });
  expect(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: '1922' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
  expect(screen.queryByText(/texted/)).toBeNull();
});

test('a successful send: one POST with body, line and a UUID send_id; draft cleared; toast with no Undo', async () => {
  api.post.mockResolvedValue({ status: 201, data: { message: { ref: 'sms:9', direction: 'out', line: '1922', failed: false } } });
  const onSent = jest.fn();

  expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  const [url, body] = api.post.mock.calls[0];

  expect(body).toMatchObject({ body: 'On our way at six', line: '1922' });
  expect(body.send_id).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').text).toBe('');
  expect(mockToasts).toEqual([{ type: 'success', m: 'Sent from 1922.', o: undefined }]);

test('Send is disabled while a send is in flight, so a double tap posts once', async () => {
  let finish;
  api.post.mockReturnValue(new Promise((resolve) => { finish = resolve; }));
  const { rerender } = setup();
  type('Hello', rerender);
  const send = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' });
  fireEvent.click(send);
  fireEvent.click(send);
  expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  expect(send).toBeDisabled();
  await act(async () => { finish({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } }); });
  rerender();
  expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
});

test('two taps in one burst post once: the in-flight guard holds before the disabled button renders', async () => {
  let finish;
  api.post.mockReturnValue(new Promise((resolve) => { finish = resolve; }));
  const { rerender } = setup();
  type('Hello', rerender);
  const send = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' });
  // One act: React renders nothing between the two taps, so the button is
  // still enabled for the second one.
  act(() => { send.click(); send.click(); });
  expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  await act(async () => { finish({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } }); });
});

test('a send the server never answered keeps the draft and the retry reuses the same send_id', async () => {
  api.post
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 0, code: 'NETWORK_ERROR', message: 'Network error. Check your connection.' })
    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } });
  const { rerender, drafts } = setup();
  type('Did my text arrive?', rerender);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(mockToasts).toHaveLength(1));
  rerender();
  expect(mockToasts[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'error', m: 'Network error. Check your connection.' });
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').text).toBe('Did my text arrive?');
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  const [first, second] = sentIds();
  expect(second).toBe(first);
});

test('no answer, then 409 still sending, then 201: all three posts carry one send_id', async () => {
  api.post
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 0, code: 'NETWORK_ERROR', message: 'Network error. Check your connection.' })
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 409, code: 'INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS', message: 'This text is still sending.' })
    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } });
  const { rerender, drafts } = setup();
  type('Running ten minutes late', rerender);
  await tapSend(1, rerender);
  await tapSend(2, rerender);
  expect(mockToasts[1]).toEqual({ type: 'info', m: 'Still sending, check the thread.', o: undefined });
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').text).toBe('Running ten minutes late');
  await tapSend(3, rerender);
  expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  const ids = sentIds();
  expect(ids[0]).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
  expect(ids).toEqual([ids[0], ids[0], ids[0]]);
  expect(mockToasts[2]).toMatchObject({ type: 'success', m: 'Sent from 1922.' });
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').text).toBe('');
});

test('an answer with no code (a rate limit in front of the route) keeps the send_id too', async () => {
  api.post
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 0, code: 'NETWORK_ERROR', message: 'Network error. Check your connection.' })
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 429, code: undefined, message: 'Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.' })
    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } });
  const { rerender } = setup();
  type('Still on for Saturday?', rerender);
  await tapSend(1, rerender);
  await tapSend(2, rerender);
  await tapSend(3, rerender);
  const ids = sentIds();
  expect(ids).toEqual([ids[0], ids[0], ids[0]]);
  expect(mockToasts[1]).toMatchObject({ type: 'error', m: 'Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.' });
});

test('a send the server answered with a failure keeps the draft and the next tap is a new attempt', async () => {
  api.post
    .mockRejectedValueOnce({ status: 502, code: 'EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR', message: 'Twilio rejected the send.' })
    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '1922', failed: false } } });
  const { rerender, drafts } = setup();
  type('Second try', rerender);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(mockToasts).toHaveLength(1));
  rerender();
  expect(drafts.current.draftOf('c-7').text).toBe('Second try');
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send from 1922' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  const [first, second] = sentIds();
  expect(second).not.toBe(first);
});

});
```

```js
  // A handled payload without `closed` still offers Reopen.

  rerender(<ItemBanner nowMs={NOW} onReopen={onReopen} onWake={onWake} item={{ waiting: true, status: 'waiting' }} />);
  expect(screen.queryByRole('button')).toBeNull();
});
```

```js
import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';

// The messages (spec 4.2), from threadModel(): day separators, centered system
// lines, and bubbles (inbound left, outbound right and tinted) that follow the
// Messages page's .sms-bubble, each with its channel tag, time and author.
// The desktop pane scrolls itself and keeps the newest message in view, like
// ClientConversation; the phone thread flows in the page.
export default function Thread({ items, variant = 'phone' }) {
  const desk = variant === 'desktop';
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (desk && ref.current) ref.current.scrollTop = ref.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [desk, items.length]);
  return (
    <div className={desk ? 'sms-messages ib-thread ib-thread-desk scroll-thin' : 'ib-thread'} ref={ref}>
      {items.length === 0 && <div className="ib-sys">No messages in the last 30 days.</div>}
      {items.map((m) => {
        if (m.type === 'day') {
          return <div key={m.key} className={desk ? 'ib-day ib-day-desk' : 'm-end ib-day'}><span>{m.label}</span></div>;
        }
        if (m.type === 'sys') {
          return (
            <div key={m.key} className="ib-sys">
              {m.text}
              {m.failure && <span className="ib-sys-fail">{` · ${m.failure}`}</span>}
            </div>
          );
        }
        return (
          <div
            key={m.key}
            className={`sms-bubble ${m.out ? 'sms-bubble-outbound' : 'sms-bubble-inbound'} ib-bubble${m.failed ? ' ib-bubble-failed' : ''}`}
          >
            <div className="ib-bubble-meta">
              <span className={desk ? 'ib-tag' : 'm-tag'}>{m.tag}</span>
              <span className="ib-bubble-time">{m.meta}</span>
            </div>
            {m.relay && <div className="ib-bubble-relay">{m.relay}</div>}
            {m.subject && <div className="ib-bubble-subject">{m.subject}</div>}
            {m.body && <div className="sms-bubble-body ib-bubble-body">{m.body}</div>}
            {m.media.length > 0 && (
              <div className="ib-media">
                {m.media.map((x) => (
                  <a key={x.key} className="ib-media-link" href={x.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{x.label}</a>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            {m.failure && <div className="ib-bubble-fail">{m.failure}</div>}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```js
// The context card (spec 4.2) from contextModel(): the phone card (label and
```

```js
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import useSheetFocus from '../../hooks/useSheetFocus';
import { snoozeOptions } from './inboxFormat';

// Snooze (spec 4.4, the design): 3 hours, Tomorrow morning, or Pick a date in
// the next 7 days, all 8:00 AM Chicago. The phone gets the shipped bottom
// sheet, the desktop a menu under the Snooze button. `onPick(untilIso)`.

const SUBCOPY = 'Hidden until then. It comes back to Waiting with its full wait time.';
const DAYS_NOTE = 'wakes at 8:00 AM on the day you pick';

export function SnoozeSheet({ name, nowMs, onPick, onClose }) {
  const sheetRef = useRef(null);
  const closers = useRef({});
  closers.current = { onClose };
  useSheetFocus(sheetRef, closers);
  const [pick, setPick] = useState(false);
  // Fixed while the sheet is open, so the times do not move under a thumb.
  const { presets, days } = useMemo(() => snoozeOptions(nowMs), []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" className="m-sheet-scrim" aria-label="Close" tabIndex={-1} onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="m-sheet ib-snooze" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`Snooze ${name}`} tabIndex={-1} ref={sheetRef}>
        <div className="m-sheet-handle" />
        <div className="m-sheet-head">
          <h2 className="m-sheet-title">Snooze {name}</h2>
          <div className="ib-sheet-sub">{SUBCOPY}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ib-snooze-opts">
          {presets.map((p) => (
            <button key={p.key} type="button" className="m-sheet-row" onClick={() => onPick(p.until)}>
              <span className="ib-sheet-icon"><Icon name={p.icon} size={20} /></span>
              <span className="ib-sheet-label">{p.label}</span>
              <span className="ib-sheet-when">{p.when}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <button type="button" className="m-sheet-row" aria-expanded={pick} onClick={() => setPick((v) => !v)}>
            <span className="ib-sheet-icon"><Icon name="calendar" size={20} /></span>
            <span className="ib-sheet-label">Pick a date</span>
            <span className="ib-sheet-when">{pick ? '' : 'next 7 days'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        {pick && (
          <>
            <div className="ib-days">
              {days.map((d) => (
                <button key={d.key} type="button" className="ib-day-btn" aria-label={d.label} onClick={() => onPick(d.until)}>
                  <span className="ib-day-dow">{d.dow}</span>
                  <span className="ib-day-num">{d.day}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="ib-days-note">{DAYS_NOTE}</div>
          </>
        )}
        <button type="button" className="m-sheet-row ib-sheet-cancel" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export function SnoozeMenu({ nowMs, onPick, onClose }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [pick, setPick] = useState(false);
  const { presets, days } = useMemo(() => snoozeOptions(nowMs), []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => {
    const first = ref.current && ref.current.querySelector('button');
    if (first) first.focus();
    const onDown = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) onClose(); };
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [onClose]);
  return (
    <div className="ib-menu" role="menu" aria-label="Snooze until" ref={ref}>
      {presets.map((p) => (
        <button key={p.key} type="button" role="menuitem" className="ib-menu-item" onClick={() => onPick(p.until)}>
          <span className="ib-menu-icon"><Icon name={p.icon} size={14} /></span>
          <span className="ib-menu-label">{p.label}</span>
          <span className="ib-menu-when">{p.when}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
      <button type="button" role="menuitem" className="ib-menu-item" aria-expanded={pick} onClick={() => setPick((v) => !v)}>
        <span className="ib-menu-icon"><Icon name="calendar" size={14} /></span>
        <span className="ib-menu-label">Pick a date</span>
        <span className="ib-menu-when">{pick ? '' : 'next 7 days'}</span>
      </button>
      {pick && (
        <>
          <div className="ib-mdays">
            {days.map((d) => (
              <button key={d.key} type="button" role="menuitem" className="ib-mday" aria-label={d.label} onClick={() => onPick(d.until)}>
                <span className="ib-mday-dow">{d.dow}</span>
                <span className="ib-mday-num">{d.day}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="ib-mdays-note">{DAYS_NOTE}</div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
