```js
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import { claimButton, stampLabel } from './inboxFormat';
import { SnoozeMenu } from './SnoozePickers';

// On it, Snooze and Done (spec 4.4), and the banner an item shows when it is
// not waiting. The phone gets three equal buttons in thumb reach (the
// shipped m-act); the desktop puts them in the thread header as btn
// variants, with Snooze as a menu.

export function PhoneActions({ state, busy, onClaim, onSnooze, onDone }) {
  const c = claimButton(state);
  return (
    <div className="m-acts ib-acts">
      <button
        type="button"
        className={c.mine ? 'm-act m-act-quiet ib-act ib-act-mine' : 'm-act m-act-quiet ib-act'}
        aria-pressed={c.mine}
        disabled={busy}
        onClick={() => onClaim(c)}
      >
        <Icon name={c.icon} size={16} />{c.label}
      </button>
      <button type="button" className="m-act m-act-quiet ib-act" disabled={busy} onClick={onSnooze}>
        <Icon name="clock" size={16} />Snooze
      </button>
      <button type="button" className="m-act m-act-quiet ib-act" disabled={busy} onClick={onDone}>
        <Icon name="check" size={16} />Done
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DesktopActions({ state, busy, nowMs, onClaim, onSnooze, onDone }) {
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const c = claimButton(state);
  return (
    <div className="ib-thead-acts">
      <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" aria-pressed={c.mine} disabled={busy} onClick={() => onClaim(c)}>
        <Icon name={c.icon} />{c.longLabel}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="btn btn-secondary"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={menu}
        disabled={busy}
        onClick={() => setMenu((v) => !v)}
      >
        <Icon name="clock" />Snooze<Icon name="down" />
      </button>
      <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={onDone}>
        <Icon name="check" />Done
      </button>
      {menu && (
        <SnoozeMenu
          nowMs={nowMs}
          onClose={() => setMenu(false)}
          onPick={(until) => { setMenu(false); onSnooze(until); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The item is not waiting: snoozed (Wake), handled in the last 7 days
 * (Reopen, with the reason when the payload carries `closed`), or simply not
 * waiting (Reopen). Reads the item payload's `status` and `snooze` (lane
 * inbox-engine) and `closed`.
 */
export function ItemBanner({ item, nowMs, busy, onWake, onReopen, variant = 'phone' }) {
  if (!item || item.waiting) return null;
  let text = 'Not waiting on a reply';
  let label = 'Reopen';
  let onTap = onReopen;
  if (item.snooze) {
    text = `Snoozed until ${stampLabel(item.snooze.until, nowMs)}`;
    label = 'Wake';
    onTap = onWake;
  } else if (item.closed) {
    text = ['Handled', item.closed.reason_text, stampLabel(item.closed.closed_at, nowMs)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  } else if (item.status === 'handled') {
    text = 'Handled in the last 7 days';
  }
  if (variant === 'desktop') {
    return (
      <div className="ib-dclosed">
        <span className="ib-closed-icon"><Icon name="check" size={14} /></span>
        <span className="ib-dclosed-text">{text}</span>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" disabled={busy} onClick={onTap}>{label}</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="ib-closed">
      <span className="ib-closed-icon"><Icon name="check" size={16} /></span>
      <span className="ib-closed-text">{text}</span>
      <button type="button" className="m-fail-retry" disabled={busy} onClick={onTap}>{label}</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `client/src/components/inbox/ReplyBar.js`:

```js
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import { useToast } from '../../context/ToastContext';
import { sendText } from './inboxApi';
import { lateNote, optOutText } from './inboxFormat';

// The reply area (spec 4.3) for the person's latest channel, from the item
// payload's `reply`:
//   text  the FROM switch (the enabled lines, on `default_line`), the box and
//         Send. The hint beside the switch names `their_line`, the line of
//         their latest inbound text: "last texted 1922" when the switch is on
//         it, a warning when it is not, nothing when they never texted us.
//         Staff get no switch, just the staff-line caption.
//   open  "Open in Thumbtack" (later: Gmail, Zola, Google Voice) and a caption.
//   none  nothing.
// Opted out replaces the box with the notice (keeping another channel's Open
// button); a bad number says it cannot receive texts.
//
// Sending: Send is disabled while a send is in flight, and the in-flight ref
// drops a second tap that lands before the disabled button renders. The send
// id comes from the drafts store and follows what the server said about it:
//   kept   no answer (NETWORK_ERROR: the server may have sent it), 409
//          INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS (the first send is still running), or an
//          answer with no code (a rate limit or a proxy, in front of the
//          route, which says nothing about the id). The next tap is the same
//          attempt, so it can never text twice.
//   spent  any other answer, a Twilio failure and INBOX_SEND_UNRECORDED
//          included: the server answers that id the same way forever, so the
//          next tap is a new attempt (or a failed text could never be resent).
// A failed send keeps the draft; the refetch after every send shows the
// failed row ("Not delivered") in the thread. The success toast has no Undo:
// a text cannot be recalled.

const STAFF_LINE = 'Sends from the staff line, same as the shift texts';
const KEEPS_SEND_ID = ['NETWORK_ERROR', 'INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS'];

function firstName(name) {
  return String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'them';
}

function OpenApp({ app, desk }) {
  if (!app || !app.url) return null;
  const caption = `Closes here on its own once you reply in ${app.name}.`;
  if (desk) {
    return (
      <div className="ib-dopen">
        <span className="ib-dopen-hint">{caption}</span>
        <a className="btn btn-primary" href={app.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          Open in {app.name}<Icon name="external" />
        </a>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <a className="ib-open-btn" href={app.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        Open in {app.name}<Icon name="external" size={16} />
      </a>
      <div className="ib-caption ib-caption-center">{caption}</div>
    </>
  );
}

function Notice({ lead, text, app, desk }) {
  if (desk) {
    return (
      <div className="ib-doptout">
        <span className="ib-feed-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="ib-doptout-text">{lead && <strong>{lead} </strong>}{text}</span>
        {app && app.url && (
          <a className="btn btn-primary" href={app.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
            Open in {app.name}<Icon name="external" />
          </a>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="m-sheet-note ib-optout" role="note">
        <span className="m-sheet-note-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="m-sheet-note-text">{lead && <strong>{lead} </strong>}{text}</span>
      </div>
      {app && app.url && (
        <a className="ib-open-btn" href={app.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          Open in {app.name}<Icon name="external" size={16} />
        </a>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default function ReplyBar({ personKey, name, reply, drafts, nowMs, onSent, variant = 'phone' }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const desk = variant === 'desktop';
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const inFlight = useRef(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => { alive.current = false; };
  }, []);

  if (!reply || reply.mode === 'none') return null;
  const wrap = (children) => (desk ? <div className="sms-reply ib-reply">{children}</div> : children);
  if (reply.mode === 'open') return wrap(<OpenApp app={reply.app} desk={desk} />);
  if (reply.opted_out) return wrap(<Notice lead="Opted out of texts." text={optOutText(reply.opted_out)} app={reply.app} desk={desk} />);
  if (reply.bad_number) return wrap(<Notice lead={null} text="This number can't receive texts." app={reply.app} desk={desk} />);

  const draft = drafts.draftOf(personKey);
  const lines = reply.lines && reply.lines.length ? reply.lines : ['888'];
  let line = lines[0];
  if (lines.includes(draft.line)) line = draft.line;
  else if (lines.includes(reply.default_line)) line = reply.default_line;
  const prefixes = reply.first_text_prefix || {};
  const prefix = prefixes[line] ? String(prefixes[line]).trim() : null;
  const their = reply.their_line || null;
  const late = lateNote(nowMs);
  const first = firstName(name);
  const placeholder = reply.staff ? `Text ${first}` : `Text ${first} from ${line}`;
  const canSend = !sending && draft.text.trim().length > 0;

  const send = async () => {
    const body = drafts.draftOf(personKey).text.trim();
    if (!body || inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setSending(true);
    const sendId = drafts.sendIdFor(personKey);
    try {
      const res = await sendText(personKey, { body, line, sendId });
      drafts.spend(personKey);
      const message = res && res.data ? res.data.message : null;
      if (message && message.failed) {
        toast.error(message.failure_reason ? `Not delivered: ${message.failure_reason}` : 'Not delivered.');
      } else {
        drafts.clear(personKey);
        toast.success(`Sent from ${(message && message.line) || line}.`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const code = err && err.code;
      if (code && !KEEPS_SEND_ID.includes(code)) drafts.spend(personKey);
      if (code === 'INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS') toast.info('Still sending, check the thread.');
      else toast.error((err && err.message) || 'Not sent. Try again.');
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setSending(false);
      if (onSent) onSent();
    }
  };

  const fromSwitch = !reply.staff && (
    desk ? (
      <div className="ib-dfrom">
        <span className="ib-dfrom-label">From</span>
        <div className="ib-dseg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Send from">
          {lines.map((l) => (
            <button key={l} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={l === line}
              className={l === line ? 'ib-dseg-btn is-on' : 'ib-dseg-btn'} onClick={() => drafts.setLine(personKey, l)}>{l}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {their && (
          <span className={line === their ? 'ib-dfrom-hint' : 'ib-dfrom-hint ib-from-warn'}>
            {line === their ? `last texted ${their}` : `heads up: they texted ${their}`}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div className="ib-from">
        <span className="ib-from-label">From</span>
        <div className="m-seg ib-seg ib-from-seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Send from">
          {lines.map((l) => (
            <button key={l} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={l === line}
              className={l === line ? 'm-seg-btn active ib-line-btn' : 'm-seg-btn ib-line-btn'} onClick={() => drafts.setLine(personKey, l)}>{l}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {their && (
          <span className={line === their ? 'ib-from-hint' : 'ib-from-hint ib-from-warn'}>
            {line === their ? `last texted ${their}` : `they texted ${their}`}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  );
  const notes = (
    <>
      {late && <div className="ib-caption ib-late">{late}</div>}
      {prefix && <div className="ib-caption">{`This first text from ${line} starts with "${prefix}"`}</div>}
    </>
  );

  if (desk) {
    return (
      <div className="sms-reply ib-reply">
        {fromSwitch}
        {notes}
        <textarea className="form-input" rows={3} maxLength={1600} aria-label="Reply" placeholder={`${placeholder}...`}
          value={draft.text} onChange={(e) => drafts.setText(personKey, e.target.value)} />
        <div className="ib-dsend">
          <span className="ib-dsend-note">
            {reply.staff ? `${STAFF_LINE}.` : `Sends as SMS from ${line}${reply.recipient_display ? ` to ${reply.recipient_display}` : ''}.`}
          </span>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={!canSend} onClick={send}>
            <Icon name="send" />{sending ? 'Sending' : (reply.staff ? 'Send text' : `Send from ${line}`)}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      {fromSwitch}
      {notes}
      <div className="ib-compose">
        <textarea className="ib-compose-input" rows={1} maxLength={1600} aria-label="Reply" placeholder={placeholder}
          value={draft.text} onChange={(e) => drafts.setText(personKey, e.target.value)} />
        <button type="button" className="ib-send" aria-label={`Send from ${line}`} disabled={!canSend} onClick={send}>
          <Icon name="send" size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>
      {reply.staff && <div className="ib-caption">{STAFF_LINE}</div>}
    </>
  );
}
```

Append to the END of `client/src/index.css` (after part A). `.ib-thead` takes `z-index: 3` because the legacy `.card > *` rule (`:301`) makes every pane child its own layer and the thread would paint over the Snooze menu; `a.btn` inside a pane gets the UI font because the legacy `.btn` (`:374`) paints IM Fell on links:

```js
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter, Routes, Route, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../../utils/api';
import { ToastProvider } from '../../context/ToastContext';
import { resetLastGood } from '../../components/inbox/lastGood';
import Inbox from './Inbox';

// The page against a fake server (lane inbox-engine's routes, spec section 8).
// `mock` prefix: babel-plugin-jest-hoist only lets a jest.mock factory close
// over variables named mock*.
const mockView = { isPhone: false, desktopView: () => false, setDesktopView: () => {} };
jest.mock('../../context/MobileViewContext', () => ({ useMobileView: () => mockView }));
jest.mock('../../utils/api', () => ({ __esModule: true, default: { get: jest.fn(), post: jest.fn(), delete: jest.fn() } }));

const hoursAgo = (h) => new Date(Date.now() - h * 3600000).toISOString();
const REPLY = {
  mode: 'text', lines: ['888'], default_line: '888', last_line: '888', recipient_display: '(312) 555-0100',
  opted_out: null, bad_number: false, proxy: false, staff: false, first_text_prefix: {}, app: null,
};
function itemOf(key, name, hours, o = {}) {
  return {
    person: { person_key: key, name, kind: 'client' }, waiting: true, waiting_since: hoursAgo(hours),
    status: 'waiting', need: `Question from ${name}`, state: { type: null }, legal_hold: false, closed: null, snooze: null,
    context: {
      kind: 'client', status_chip: 'Booked', event_type_label: 'Wedding', guests: 120,
      when_text: 'Sat Oct 24', where_text: 'Example Hall', proposal: { id: 4, status_label: 'Signed', chip: 'Signed' },
      money: null, links: { client_id: 4, proposal_id: 4, event_id: 4 },
    },
    thread: [{ ref: `sms:${key}`, direction: 'in', channel: 'text', line: '888', at: hoursAgo(hours), text: `Hello from ${name}`, media: [] }],
    reply: REPLY,
    ...o,
  };
}
const rowOf = (it, o = {}) => ({
  person_key: it.person.person_key, name: it.person.name, kind: 'client', need: it.need,
  waiting_since: it.waiting_since, hot: false, channels: ['text_888'], state: it.state, ...o,
});
const OLD = itemOf('c-1', 'Avery Example', 46);
const NEW = itemOf('c-2', 'Jo Test', 2, { state: { type: 'unseen' } });
const LIST = { generated_at: hoursAgo(0), ai: { status: 'on' }, waiting: [rowOf(NEW), rowOf(OLD)], snoozed: [], handled: [], feeds: [] };

let mockItems;
let mockList;
function serve({ failList = false } = {}) {
  api.get.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url === '/admin/inbox') {
      return failList
        ? Promise.reject({ status: 0, code: 'NETWORK_ERROR', message: 'Network error. Check your connection.' })
        : Promise.resolve({ status: 200, data: mockList });
    }
    const key = decodeURIComponent(url.replace('/admin/inbox/', ''));
    const hit = mockItems[key];
    if (hit && hit.moved) return Promise.resolve({ status: 404, data: { code: 'INBOX_MOVED', moved_to: hit.moved } });
    return Promise.resolve(hit ? { status: 200, data: hit } : { status: 404, data: { code: 'NOT_FOUND' } });
  });
  api.post.mockImplementation((url) => {
    if (url.endsWith('/seen')) return Promise.resolve({ status: 204 });
    if (url.endsWith('/actions')) return Promise.resolve({ status: 200, data: { id: 11 } });
    return Promise.resolve({ status: 201, data: { message: { line: '888', failed: false } } });
  });
}
const seenPosts = () => api.post.mock.calls.filter(([u]) => u.endsWith('/seen')).map(([u]) => u);
const itemGets = () => api.get.mock.calls.map(([u]) => u).filter((u) => u !== '/admin/inbox');

function Where() {
  return <div data-testid="where">{useLocation().pathname}</div>;
}
function mount(path) {
  return render(
    <ToastProvider>
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/inbox/:personKey?" element={<><Inbox /><Where /></>} />
        </Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}
const where = () => screen.getByTestId('where').textContent;

beforeEach(() => {
  mockView.isPhone = false;
  mockItems = { 'c-1': OLD, 'c-2': NEW };
  mockList = LIST;
  resetLastGood();
  window.localStorage.clear();
});

describe('desktop', () => {
  test('selects the longest wait on its own and never marks it seen', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox');
    expect(await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(itemGets()).toEqual(['/admin/inbox/c-1']);
    expect(screen.getByText('Avery Example', { selector: '.ib-drow-name' }).closest('.ib-drow')).toHaveClass('is-selected');
    expect(where()).toBe('/inbox');
    expect(seenPosts()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a click is a deliberate open: the URL names the person and seen is written once', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox');
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Jo Test', { selector: '.ib-drow-name' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Hello from Jo Test')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(where()).toBe('/inbox/c-2');
    await waitFor(() => expect(seenPosts()).toEqual(['/admin/inbox/c-2/seen']));
    // The header drops "Not read yet" on a deliberate open; the row keeps it
    // until the list reloads.
    expect(screen.queryByText('Not read yet', { selector: '.ib-thead .chip' })).toBeNull();
  });

  test('Done on an opened person moves to the next one on its own, without a seen write', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox/c-1');
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    await waitFor(() => expect(seenPosts()).toEqual(['/admin/inbox/c-1/seen']));
    mockList = { ...LIST, waiting: [rowOf(NEW)] };
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Done' }));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Hello from Jo Test')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(where()).toBe('/inbox');
    expect(api.post).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/admin/inbox/c-1/actions', { action: 'done' });
    expect(screen.getByText('Done. Moved to Handled.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(seenPosts()).toEqual(['/admin/inbox/c-1/seen']);
  });

  test('a draft survives the refetch that brings in their reply', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox/c-1');
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' }), { target: { value: 'Half-written answer' } });
    mockItems = {
      ...mockItems,
      'c-1': { ...OLD, thread: [...OLD.thread, { ref: 'sms:new', direction: 'in', channel: 'text', line: '888', at: hoursAgo(0), text: 'One more thing', media: [] }] },
    };
    await act(async () => { document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); });
    expect(await screen.findByText('One more thing')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' })).toHaveValue('Half-written answer');
  });

  test('a draft is kept per person: switch to someone else and back, it is still there', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox/c-1');
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' }), { target: { value: 'For Avery' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Jo Test', { selector: '.ib-drow-name' }));
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Jo Test');
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' })).toHaveValue('');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Avery Example', { selector: '.ib-drow-name' }));
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Reply' })).toHaveValue('For Avery');
  });

  test('a list that fails to load is the error card, never an empty inbox', async () => {
    serve({ failList: true });
    mount('/inbox');
    expect(await screen.findByText("Couldn't load the inbox")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Nobody's waiting")).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText('Feed status unknown until the inbox loads')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('a key that moved follows the hint and says so', async () => {
    serve();
    mockItems = { ...mockItems, 'p-3125550100': { moved: 'c-2' } };
    mount('/inbox/p-3125550100');
    await waitFor(() => expect(where()).toBe('/inbox/c-2'));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Hello from Jo Test')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('This conversation moved.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe('phone', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { mockView.isPhone = true; });

  test('the list loads no item; tapping a card opens it and writes seen once', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox');
    const card = await screen.findByText('Avery Example', { selector: '.m-card-title' });
    expect(itemGets()).toEqual([]);

  });

  test('Snooze opens the sheet; a preset snoozes until 8:00 AM Chicago and returns to the list', async () => {
    serve();
    mount('/inbox/c-1');
    await screen.findByText('Hello from Avery Example');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Snooze' }));
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Snooze Avery Example' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Hidden until then. It comes back to Waiting with its full wait time.')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Tomorrow morning/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(where()).toBe('/inbox'));
    const [, body] = api.post.mock.calls.find(([u]) => u.endsWith('/actions'));
    expect(body.action).toBe('snooze');
    expect(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Chicago', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(body.until)).replace(/\u202f/g, ' ')).toBe('8:00 AM');
  });
});
```

```js
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Icon from '../adminos/Icon';
import StatusChip from '../adminos/StatusChip';
import { WaitingRow, SnoozedRow } from './WaitingRows';
import HandledList from './HandledList';
import FeedsLine from './FeedsLine';
import Thread from './Thread';
import ReplyBar from './ReplyBar';
import { DesktopActions, ItemBanner } from './ItemActions';
import { ErrorCard, ItemGone, ItemLoading, ListEmpty, ListError, ListLoading } from './InboxStates';
import { threadModel } from './inboxThread';
import { channelJoin, stateChip, stateNote, threadChannels, waitParts } from './inboxFormat';

// The desktop's first two panes (spec 11.3): People waiting (LIVE, the
// Waiting and "Handled, last 7 days" tabs, the Snoozed group, the feeds
// footer) and the thread (header with the wait, channels and actions, the
// messages, the composer). The context pane is ContextViews.ContextPane.

export function ListPane({ list, waiting, itemKey, nowMs, open, run }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('waiting');
  const ready = list.status === 'ready';
  const data = list.data || {};
  const handled = ready ? data.handled || [] : [];
  const snoozed = ready ? data.snoozed || [] : [];
  let count = '';
  if (ready) count = String(waiting.length);
  else if (list.status === 'error') count = '?';
  return (
    <div className="card card-flush ib-pane">
      <div className="card-head">
        <h3><Icon name="mail" size={12} /> People waiting <span className="k">Live</span></h3>
        <span className="k">{count}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="nat-tabs ib-tabs">
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={tab === 'waiting'} className={tab === 'waiting' ? 'nat-tab is-active' : 'nat-tab'} onClick={() => setTab('waiting')}>
          Waiting <span className="ib-tab-count">{count}</span>
          {ready && waiting.length > 0 && <span className="nat-dot danger" />}
        </button>
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={tab === 'handled'} className={tab === 'handled' ? 'nat-tab is-active' : 'nat-tab'} onClick={() => setTab('handled')}>
          Handled, last 7 days <span className="ib-tab-count">{ready ? handled.length : ''}</span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="scroll-thin ib-pane-scroll">
        {list.status === 'loading' && <ListLoading variant="desktop" />}
        {list.status === 'error' && <ListError variant="desktop" lastGood={list.lastGood} pending={list.pending} onRetry={list.refresh} />}
        {ready && tab === 'waiting' && (
          <>
            {waiting.length === 0 && <ListEmpty variant="desktop" />}
            {waiting.map((r) => (
              <WaitingRow key={r.person_key} row={r} nowMs={nowMs} selected={r.person_key === itemKey} onOpen={open} />
            ))}
            {snoozed.map((s) => (
              <SnoozedRow key={s.person_key} variant="desktop" row={s} nowMs={nowMs}
                onWake={(row) => run(row.person_key, 'wake', { name: row.name })} />
            ))}
          </>
        )}
        {ready && tab === 'handled' && (
          <HandledList variant="desktop" rows={handled} nowMs={nowMs} onReopen={(h) => run(h.personKey, 'reopen', { name: h.name })} />
        )}
      </div>
      {list.status !== 'loading' && (
        <FeedsLine variant="desktop" feeds={data.feeds} ai={data.ai} nowMs={nowMs} failed={list.status === 'error'} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ThreadPane({ item, itemKey, deliberate, drafts, nowMs, busy, run, refresh, backToList }) {
  if (!itemKey) {
    return <div className="card card-flush ib-pane ib-thread-pane"><div className="ib-dnote">Pick someone from the list.</div></div>;
  }
  if (item.status === 'loading' || item.status === 'idle') {
    return <div className="card card-flush ib-pane ib-thread-pane"><ItemLoading variant="desktop" /></div>;
  }
  if (item.status === 'error') {
    return (
      <div className="card card-flush ib-pane ib-thread-pane">
        <ErrorCard variant="desktop" title="Couldn't load this conversation" body="Nothing was lost; the messages just didn't arrive."
          onRetry={item.refresh} pending={false} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (item.status !== 'ready' || !item.data) {
    return <div className="card card-flush ib-pane ib-thread-pane"><ItemGone variant="desktop" onBack={backToList} /></div>;
  }
  const d = item.data;
  const name = d.person.name;
  const wait = d.waiting ? waitParts(d.waiting_since, nowMs) : null;
  const chip = d.waiting ? stateChip(d.state, { deliberate }) : null;
  const note = d.waiting ? stateNote(d.state, nowMs) : null;
  const stretch = threadChannels(d.thread, d.waiting ? d.waiting_since : null);
  const chans = stretch.length ? stretch : threadChannels(d.thread);
  // "Waiting 46 hrs · Text 1922 + Email · You said Monday" (the design).
  const tail = [chans.length ? channelJoin(chans) : null, note].filter(Boolean);
  return (
    <div className="card card-flush ib-pane ib-thread-pane">
      <div className="ib-thead">
        <div className="ib-thead-main">
          <div className="ib-thead-name">{name}</div>
          <div className="ib-thead-sub">
            {chip && <StatusChip kind={chip.kind}>{chip.label}</StatusChip>}
            <span>
              {wait && <>Waiting <span className={wait.hot ? 'ib-wait-long ib-hot' : 'ib-wait-long'}>{wait.long}</span>{tail.length ? ' · ' : ''}</>}
              {tail.join(' · ')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        {d.waiting && (
          <DesktopActions
            key={itemKey}
            state={d.state}
            busy={busy}
            nowMs={nowMs}
            onClaim={(c) => run(itemKey, c.action, { takeoverFrom: c.takeoverFrom })}
            onSnooze={(until) => run(itemKey, 'snooze', { until, name })}
            onDone={() => run(itemKey, 'done', { name })}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      <ItemBanner variant="desktop" item={d} nowMs={nowMs} busy={busy}
        onWake={() => run(itemKey, 'wake', { name })} onReopen={() => run(itemKey, 'reopen', { name })} />
      {item.refreshFailed && (
        <div className="ib-refresh-fail" role="alert">
          <span>Couldn't refresh this conversation. It may be out of date.</span>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={item.refresh}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <Thread variant="desktop" items={threadModel(d.thread, nowMs)} />
      <ReplyBar key={itemKey} variant="desktop" personKey={itemKey} name={name} reply={d.reply} drafts={drafts} nowMs={nowMs} onSent={refresh} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```js
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useOutletContext, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useMobileView } from '../../context/MobileViewContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/ToastContext';
import InboxPhone from '../mobile/InboxPhone';
import useInboxList from '../../components/inbox/useInboxList';
import useInboxItem from '../../components/inbox/useInboxItem';
import useInboxDrafts from '../../components/inbox/useInboxDrafts';
import useInboxActions from '../../components/inbox/useInboxActions';
import useNow from '../../components/inbox/useNow';
import { ListPane, ThreadPane } from '../../components/inbox/DesktopPanes';
import { ContextPane } from '../../components/inbox/ContextViews';
import { contextModel } from '../../components/inbox/inboxContext';
import { firstWaitingKey, isPersonKey, sortWaiting } from '../../components/inbox/inboxFormat';

// Inbox (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-inbox-design.md; design
// docs/design-artifacts/2026-10-06-inbox/). One route, /inbox/:personKey?, so
// this component stays mounted between the list and an opened item: the list
// keeps polling, and the drafts held here survive every refetch, every
// person switch and the phone's list and item screens.
//
// The fork lives here (spec 10): at phone width InboxPhone renders unless the
// screen is pinned to Desktop view (screen keys inbox and inbox-item); the
// desktop is three panes. Seen (spec 4.2): only a DELIBERATE open marks a
// person seen, meaning the URL names them (a tap, a link, Back to them). The
// desktop's own pick of the longest wait never writes the URL, so it never
// marks anyone seen, on the first load or after Done.

export default function Inbox() {
  const { personKey } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isPhone, desktopView } = useMobileView();
  const phone = isPhone && !desktopView(personKey ? 'inbox-item' : 'inbox');
  const { refreshBadges } = useOutletContext() || {};
  const nowMs = useNow();
  const drafts = useInboxDrafts();
  const list = useInboxList();
  // The person just closed on the desktop, skipped by the auto-pick until the
  // list reload that no longer has them lands.
  const [skipKey, setSkipKey] = useState(null);
  const waiting = list.data ? sortWaiting(list.data.waiting) : [];
  const autoKey = !phone && !personKey ? firstWaitingKey(waiting, skipKey) : null;
  const itemKey = personKey || autoKey;
  const item = useInboxItem(itemKey);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  // After any tap or send: the list, the item and the badges (spec 10).
  const live = useRef({});
  live.current = { list, item, refreshBadges };
  const refresh = useCallback(({ list: doList = true, item: doItem = true } = {}) => {
    const cur = live.current;
    if (doList) cur.list.refresh();
    if (doItem) cur.item.refresh();
    if (cur.refreshBadges) cur.refreshBadges();
  }, []);
  const actions = useInboxActions({ refresh });

  const seenFor = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!personKey) { seenFor.current = null; return; }
    if (!isPersonKey(personKey) || seenFor.current === personKey) return;
    seenFor.current = personKey;
    actions.markSeen(personKey);
  }, [personKey, actions]);

  // An unknown number that became a client: follow the server's hint. A stale
  // key from the desktop's own pick just waits for the list to catch up.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (item.status !== 'moved') return;
    if (personKey && item.key === personKey) {
      toast.info('This conversation moved.');
      navigate(`/inbox/${item.movedTo}`, { replace: true });
    } else {
      refresh({ item: false });
    }
  }, [item.status, item.key, item.movedTo, personKey, navigate, toast, refresh]);

  useEffect(() => { setSkipKey(null); }, [list.data]);

  const open = useCallback((key) => navigate(`/inbox/${key}`), [navigate]);
  const backToList = useCallback(() => navigate('/inbox', { replace: true }), [navigate]);

  // Done and Snooze leave the item: the phone goes back to the list, the
  // desktop moves to the next person on its own (no seen write).
  const run = useCallback(async (key, action, opts) => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await actions.act(key, action, opts);
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok && (action === 'done' || action === 'snooze')) {
      setSkipKey(key);
      if (personKey === key) backToList();
    }
    return ok;
  }, [actions, personKey, backToList]);

  const shared = { list, waiting, item, itemKey, deliberate: Boolean(personKey), drafts, nowMs, busy, run, open, refresh, backToList };
  if (phone) return <InboxPhone {...shared} />;

  const model = item.status === 'ready' && item.data
    ? contextModel(item.data.context, { legalHold: item.data.legal_hold })
    : null;
  return (
    <div className="ib-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <div className="page-title">Inbox</div>
          <div className="page-subtitle">Everyone waiting on a reply from Dallas or Zul. Longest wait first, one row per person.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="ib-grid">
        <ListPane {...shared} />
        <ThreadPane {...shared} />
        <ContextPane model={model} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `client/src/pages/mobile/InboxPhone.js`:

```js
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useOutletContext } from 'react-router-dom';
import StatusChip from '../../components/adminos/StatusChip';
import { WaitingCard, SnoozedRow } from '../../components/inbox/WaitingRows';
import HandledList from '../../components/inbox/HandledList';
import FeedsLine from '../../components/inbox/FeedsLine';
import Thread from '../../components/inbox/Thread';
import ReplyBar from '../../components/inbox/ReplyBar';
import { ContextCard } from '../../components/inbox/ContextViews';
import { ItemBanner, PhoneActions } from '../../components/inbox/ItemActions';
import { SnoozeSheet } from '../../components/inbox/SnoozePickers';
import { ErrorCard, ItemGone, ItemLoading, ListEmpty, ListError, ListLoading } from '../../components/inbox/InboxStates';
import { contextModel, kindLine } from '../../components/inbox/inboxContext';
import { threadModel } from '../../components/inbox/inboxThread';
import { channelCount, stateChip, stateNote, threadChannels, waitParts } from '../../components/inbox/inboxFormat';

// Phone Inbox (spec 4 and 11.2; design InboxPhone.dc.html). Renders INSIDE
// AdminLayout's scrolling .m-main; the header and the tab bar (Inbox first)
// are the chrome's. /inbox is the list; /inbox/:personKey is the full-screen
// item, whose rich header (name, kind, guests) the chrome draws from
// setHeaderDetail. Everything stateful (the list poll, the item read, the
// drafts, the taps) is the page's (pages/admin/Inbox.js) and arrives as props.

const scrollHost = () => document.getElementById('main-content');

function PhoneList({ list, waiting, nowMs, open, run, tab, setTab }) {
  const ready = list.status === 'ready';
  const data = list.data || {};
  const snoozed = ready ? data.snoozed || [] : [];
  const handled = ready ? data.handled || [] : [];
  let waitCount = '';
  if (ready) waitCount = String(waiting.length);
  else if (list.status === 'error') waitCount = '?';
  const oldest = waiting.length ? waitParts(waiting[0].waiting_since, nowMs) : null;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="m-listbar">
        <div className="m-seg ib-seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Inbox view">
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={tab === 'waiting'}
            className={tab === 'waiting' ? 'm-seg-btn active' : 'm-seg-btn'} onClick={() => setTab('waiting')}>
            Waiting<span className="ib-seg-count">{waitCount}</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={tab === 'handled'}
            className={tab === 'handled' ? 'm-seg-btn active' : 'm-seg-btn'} onClick={() => setTab('handled')}>
            Handled<span className="ib-seg-count">{ready ? handled.length : ''}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {list.status === 'loading' && <ListLoading />}
      {list.status === 'error' && <ListError lastGood={list.lastGood} pending={list.pending} onRetry={list.refresh} />}
      {ready && tab === 'waiting' && (
        <>
          {waiting.length === 0 && <ListEmpty />}
          {waiting.map((r) => <WaitingCard key={r.person_key} row={r} nowMs={nowMs} onOpen={open} />)}
          {oldest && <div className="m-end"><span>{`${waiting.length} waiting · oldest ${oldest.long}`}</span></div>}
          {snoozed.map((s) => (
            <SnoozedRow key={s.person_key} row={s} nowMs={nowMs} onWake={(row) => run(row.person_key, 'wake', { name: row.name })} />
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {ready && tab === 'handled' && (
        <HandledList rows={handled} nowMs={nowMs} onReopen={(h) => run(h.personKey, 'reopen', { name: h.name })} />
      )}
      {list.status !== 'loading' && <FeedsLine feeds={data.feeds} ai={data.ai} nowMs={nowMs} failed={list.status === 'error'} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function PhoneItem({ item, itemKey, deliberate, drafts, nowMs, busy, run, refresh, backToList }) {
  const { setHeaderDetail } = useOutletContext() || {};
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState(false);
  const d = item.status === 'ready' ? item.data : null;
  const name = d ? d.person.name : '';
  const kind = d ? kindLine(d.context) : '';
  const guests = d && d.context && d.context.guests !== undefined ? d.context.guests : null;

  // An item opens at its top, not at the list's scroll offset.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const host = scrollHost();
    if (host) host.scrollTop = 0;
  }, []);
  // The chrome's rich header: back, name, guests, "Booked · Wedding".
  const header = useMemo(() => (name ? { title: name, kind, guests } : null), [name, kind, guests]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!setHeaderDetail) return undefined;
    setHeaderDetail(header);
    return () => setHeaderDetail(null);
  }, [header, setHeaderDetail]);

  if (item.status === 'loading' || item.status === 'idle') return <ItemLoading />;
  if (item.status === 'error') {
    return (
      <ErrorCard title="Couldn't load this conversation" body="Nothing was lost; the messages just didn't arrive."
        onRetry={item.refresh} pending={false} />
    );
  }
  if (!d) return <ItemGone onBack={backToList} />;

  const wait = d.waiting ? waitParts(d.waiting_since, nowMs) : null;
  const chip = d.waiting ? stateChip(d.state, { deliberate }) : null;
  const note = d.waiting ? stateNote(d.state, nowMs) : null;
  const chans = threadChannels(d.thread);
  const hasReply = d.reply && d.reply.mode !== 'none';
  return (
    <div className="ib-item">
      <div className="ib-item-body">
        <ItemBanner item={d} nowMs={nowMs} busy={busy}
          onWake={() => run(itemKey, 'wake', { name })} onReopen={() => run(itemKey, 'reopen', { name })} />
        {item.refreshFailed && (
          <div className="m-stale" role="alert">
            <span className="m-stale-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>Couldn't refresh. This may be out of date.</span>
            <button type="button" className="m-fail-retry" onClick={item.refresh}>Retry</button>
          </div>
        )}
        {wait && (
          <div className="m-detail-when">
            <div className="m-detail-whenline">
              <span>Waiting <span className={wait.hot ? 'ib-wait-long ib-hot' : 'ib-wait-long'}>{wait.long}</span></span>
              {chip && <StatusChip kind={chip.kind}>{chip.label}</StatusChip>}
              {note && <span className="m-detail-setup">{note}</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <ContextCard model={contextModel(d.context, { legalHold: d.legal_hold })} />
        <h2 className="m-more-heading ib-msgs-head">{chans.length ? `Messages · ${channelCount(chans)}` : 'Messages'}</h2>
        <Thread items={threadModel(d.thread, nowMs)} />
      </div>
      {(d.waiting || hasReply) && (
        <div className="ib-dock">
          {d.waiting && (
            <PhoneActions state={d.state} busy={busy}
              onClaim={(c) => run(itemKey, c.action, { takeoverFrom: c.takeoverFrom })}
              onSnooze={() => setSheet(true)}
              onDone={() => run(itemKey, 'done', { name })} />
          )}
          <ReplyBar personKey={itemKey} name={name} reply={d.reply} drafts={drafts} nowMs={nowMs} onSent={refresh} />
        </div>
      )}
      {sheet && (
        <SnoozeSheet name={name} nowMs={nowMs} onClose={() => setSheet(false)}
          onPick={(until) => { setSheet(false); run(itemKey, 'snooze', { until, name }); }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function InboxPhone(props) {
  // The list's tab and scroll offset live here, above the list/item switch,
  // so Back from an item lands where the list was.
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('waiting');
  const offset = useRef(0);
  const { itemKey, open, list } = props;
  const openItem = (key) => {
    const host = scrollHost();
    offset.current = host ? host.scrollTop : 0;
    open(key);
  };
  const ready = list.status === 'ready';
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (itemKey || !ready) return;
    const host = scrollHost();
    if (host) host.scrollTop = offset.current;
  }, [itemKey, ready]);
  // .ib-phone draws no box: it marks the phone Inbox as open for the toast
  // rules (index.css), whichever screen below is showing.
  return (
    <div className="ib-phone">
      {itemKey
        ? <PhoneItem key={itemKey} {...props} />
        : <PhoneList {...props} open={openItem} tab={tab} setTab={setTab} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

In `ARCHITECTURE.md`, after line 2079 (the **Assignment sheet** bullet, last of "### Admin PWA (Mobile Admin, spec 2026-08-13)"), insert:

```markdown
- **Inbox (spec 2026-10-06)**: `client/src/pages/admin/Inbox.js` is ONE route, `/inbox/:personKey?`, so the page (its 60 s list poll and the drafts it holds) stays mounted between the list and an opened item. It forks like Events: `InboxPhone` (`client/src/pages/mobile/`) at phone width unless the screen key (`inbox`, or `inbox-item` for an opened person) is pinned to Desktop view, else three panes (people waiting, the thread, the context). Seen is written ONLY for a deliberate open, meaning the URL names the person; the desktop's own pick of the longest wait never writes the URL, so it never marks anyone seen. Reads are always live (`api.get`, never `offlineGet`): a stored copy could hide someone waiting, and a failed list load shows the error card with the last good load (memory plus `localStorage`), never an empty or stale list. The item read resolves a 404 so it can follow `INBOX_MOVED`. Drafts and send ids are per person (`useInboxDrafts`): an id is kept while the server has not settled that send (no answer, 409 `INBOX_SEND_IN_PROGRESS`, or an answer with no code from a limiter or proxy in front of the route) and replaced once it answered anything else, `INBOX_SEND_UNRECORDED` included; Send also ignores a second tap while one is in flight. The FROM hint names `reply.their_line`, the line of their latest inbound text. Undo toasts ride `ToastContext`'s optional `{ action, duration }`; while Inbox is open, and only then, the toast sits under the phone header and is square on House Lights (`:has(.ib-page)` and `:has(.ib-phone)` in `index.css`, pinned by `client/src/utils/toastCss.test.js`). The sidebar and the Inbox tab (first on the phone) draw "!" when `inbox_waiting` is null, and AdminLayout sets it null when the badge fetch fails.
```

```js
// Static server with SPA fallback for a CRA build directory. Scratch tool.
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const root = process.argv[2];
const port = Number(process.argv[3] || 4321);
const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json', '.png': 'image/png', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.webp': 'image/webp', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.map': 'application/json', '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg' };
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const url = decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);
  let file = path.join(root, url);
  if (!file.startsWith(root)) { res.writeHead(403); return res.end(); }
  fs.stat(file, (err, st) => {
    if (err || !st.isFile()) file = path.join(root, 'index.html');
    fs.readFile(file, (e, buf) => {
      if (e) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('nf'); }
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[path.extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream' });
      res.end(buf);
    });
  });
}).listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log('listening ' + port));
```

```js
// Scratch visual harness: the lane build at 4321 with stubbed APIs, and the
// design snapshot at 4322, screenshotted side by side.
const { chromium } = require(process.env.LANE_ROOT + '/node_modules/playwright-core');
const install = require('./fixtures');
const OUT = __dirname + '/shots/';
require('fs').mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

async function app(browser, { name, path, width, height, skin, mode = 'ok', act }) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height }, serviceWorkers: 'block', deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
  await install(ctx, mode);
  await ctx.addInitScript(({ skin }) => {
    localStorage.setItem('token', 'test-token');
    localStorage.setItem('drb-admin-prefs-1', JSON.stringify({ skin, density: 'comfy', sidebar: 'full' }));
  }, { skin });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()); });
  await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4321' + path, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  if (act) await act(page);
  await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + name + '.png' });
  await ctx.close();
  return { name, errors };
}

    if (el) await el.screenshot({ path: OUT + 'design-' + id + '.png' });

  await ctx.close();
}
```

Write `$SCRATCH/inbox-review/live.js`:

```js
// Live pass against the lane servers (lane C1 merged) on the shared dev DB.
// Reads only, plus one Done and its Undo. Never presses Send.
const { chromium } = require(process.env.LANE_ROOT + '/node_modules/playwright-core');
const fs = require('fs');
const token = fs.readFileSync(__dirname + '/admin.jwt', 'utf8').trim();
fs.mkdirSync(__dirname + '/shots', { recursive: true });

async function run(browser, width, height, skin, act) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height }, serviceWorkers: 'block' });
  await ctx.addInitScript(([t, s]) => {
    localStorage.setItem('token', t);
    localStorage.setItem('drb-admin-prefs-1', JSON.stringify({ skin: s, density: 'comfy', sidebar: 'full' }));
  }, [token, skin]);
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  const calls = [];
  const errors = [];
  page.on('request', (r) => { if (r.url().includes('/api/admin/inbox')) calls.push(`${r.method()} ${new URL(r.url()).pathname}`); });
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()); });
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3001/inbox', { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${__dirname}/shots/live-${width}-${skin}.png` });
  const out = { width, skin, seenOnLoad: calls.filter((c) => c.endsWith('/seen')).length };
  if (act) Object.assign(out, await act(page, calls));
  out.errors = errors;
  await ctx.close();
  return out;
}

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const results = [];
  for (const skin of ['dark', 'light']) {
    results.push(await run(browser, 390, 844, skin));
    results.push(await run(browser, 1440, 900, skin));
  }
  // One deliberate open, then Done and its Undo, on the desktop.
  results.push(await run(browser, 1440, 900, 'dark', async (page, calls) => {
    const rows = page.locator('.ib-drow');
    if (await rows.count() < 2) return { skipped: 'fewer than two people waiting on the dev DB' };
    await rows.nth(1).click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    const seenAfterOpen = calls.filter((c) => c.endsWith('/seen')).length;
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Done' }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    return {
      seenAfterOpen,
      done: calls.some((c) => c.startsWith('POST') && c.endsWith('/actions')),
      undo: calls.some((c) => c.startsWith('DELETE /api/admin/inbox/actions/')),
    };
  }));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 1));
  await browser.close();
})();
```

Run, from the lane root: `LANE_ROOT="$PWD" node "$SCRATCH/inbox-review/live.js"`. It writes to the shared dev DB, and only this: the one deliberate open POSTs `/seen`, which upserts that person's `inbox_seen` row and, for a client, marks their texts read (`sms_messages.read_at`, as opening the thread in Messages does); Done then Undo writes one `inbox_actions` row and stamps it undone. Nothing is sent. Expected: every entry has `"errors": []` and `"seenOnLoad": 0` (the desktop's own pick and the phone list write no seen); the last entry reads `"seenAfterOpen": 1, "done": true, "undo": true` (or says it skipped because the dev DB has fewer than two people waiting, in which case seed nothing and note it for the reviewer). Look at the `live-*` screenshots: the sidebar and the Inbox tab carry the same count. Do NOT press Send anywhere: sending is pinned by Tasks 28 and 29, and the dev DB is shared.
